The keypad connects by USB-C, and the listing shows a stand and a USB-C to USB-C cable in the box, plus 2 AAA batteries listed for the dialpad. It carries a 1-year limited hardware warranty. The listing also mentions an included 3-month Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps membership, but it doesn't show redemption terms or regional limits, so check current eligibility before counting on it.
whyWeLikeIt: It looks like a miniature command center: little screens that change with the app you're in, and a real dial for the adjustments that feel awkward with a mouse. It's a distinctive addition to a creator desk, and useful to anyone who likes physical controls.
highlights: 9 customizable LCD keys plus a tactile control dial and roller
Up to 15 keypad pages by profile; upload your own icons (listed)
Integrations named in the listing: Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Figma, DaVinci Resolve, Spotify, Zoom and more
Requires Logi Options+ (recent Windows and macOS)
USB-C keypad; stand, USB-C cable and 2 AAA batteries listed
Listing mentions a 3-month Adobe Creative Cloud offer; check terms

name: Elgato Stream Deck +, Studio Controller
shortDescription: A studio controller with 8 customizable LCD keys, a touch strip and 4 multifunction dials for controlling audio, video and apps with physical buttons.
description: A miniature control console for your desk. The Elgato Stream Deck + has 8 customizable LCD keys, a touch strip and 4 multifunction dials (360-degree encoders with a push function), so you get tactile control with visual feedback instead of hunting through app menus. The listing describes using it as an audio mixer, studio controller or production console, with Multi Actions to trigger several steps at once and Smart Profiles that switch the layout automatically per app. It unlocks Elgato Wave Link mixing software, and the listing names plugins for Camera Hub, Control Center, OBS, Twitch, YouTube, Twitter, Discord, Spotify and Philips Hue, plus the Stream Deck Store for more plugins, icon packs and royalty-free audio. Listed specs: 140 x 138 x 110 mm (5.5 x 5.4 x 4.3 in), about 465-470 g, USB-C connectivity, and Windows 10 (64-bit) or macOS 10.13+ required. Listed contents: the device and a USB cable. It carries a 2-year manufacturer warranty as listed. This is the Stream Deck + (8 keys, 4 dials, touch strip), not the 15-key Stream Deck MK.2, Neo, XL or Studio.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a row of app menus into physical buttons and a dial you can reach without looking. Streamers and podcasters are the obvious fit, but anyone who juggles volume, lighting or app switching during calls will find a use for it.
highlights: 8 customizable LCD keys, a touch strip, 4 multifunction dials
Multi Actions and Smart Profiles that switch per app
Unlocks Elgato Wave Link mixing software
Plugins listed: OBS, Twitch, YouTube, Discord, Spotify, Philips Hue and more
USB-C; Windows 10 (64-bit) or macOS 10.13+; includes USB cable
Not the 15-key Stream Deck MK.2, Neo, XL or Studio

name: HOZO NeoRulerGO Digital Rolling Ruler
shortDescription: A pocket-sized digital rolling ruler: roll it across a surface and a measurement appears on its screen.
description: This looks like a tiny remote. It measures things. The HOZO NeoRulerGO is a rechargeable digital measuring tool with a wheel you roll across a surface and an LCD screen that shows the reading as you go, instead of reading marks off a tape. The listing lists linear, circular, arbitrary curve, irregular surface and cylinder diameter measurement, with a precision of ±0.04 inch (±1 mm) on the digital screen, and a Class I laser (under 1 mW) for the laser line. It has 93 built-in scales (52 US standard, 41 metric) and switches between mm, cm, m, inch, ft, ft+inch, yard, mile and km, plus support for unlimited custom scales for things like unscaled or misprinted floor plans. There are left-hand and right-hand modes, a landscape/portrait LCD, and it shuts down automatically after a minute of inactivity. Over Bluetooth, the free MEAZOR app can transfer data, export to CAD files (DXF, PDF, JPG), build and sync custom scale lists, and calibrate the device. The listing's own bullets and spec table give different dimensions and weight for this same ASIN, so we're not stating either here; check the current listing before you buy. Warranty: 1-year limited, per the listing.
whyWeLikeIt: It replaces the mental math of reading a tape measure with a straight digital number, and does it on curves and odd shapes a tape can't follow well. It's a small, unusual gadget that DIYers, makers and anyone who likes clever tools will get a kick out of.
highlights: Roll it across a surface; the reading shows on its own LCD screen
Linear, circular, curve, irregular-surface and cylinder measurement (listed)
±0.04 in (±1 mm) precision; Class I laser (<1 mW)
93 built-in scales (52 US, 41 metric) plus unlimited custom scales
Bluetooth + free MEAZOR app: CAD export, custom scales, calibration

name: SUBSOCCER S3 Edge Bench Soccer Game
shortDescription: A portable two-bench soccer table: players sit facing each other and control the ball with their feet to score.
description: Soccer. But you never leave the bench. The SUBSOCCER S3 Edge is a portable bench soccer set: two enclosed benches face each other across a netted playing table, and each player controls the ball with their feet from a seated position to score into the opponent's net. The listing describes this as the next-generation version of the original S3, now with a dedicated gaming mat included, redesigned bench legs for added stability, and an anthracite grey finish over a powder-coated steel frame. It sets up with the included tools in minutes and packs away for home, office, beach or backyard use, and each bench is listed to support up to 150 kg. The listing recommends it for players aged 6 and up. Listed contents: the table, 2 benches with nets, an official SUBSOCCER game ball, assembly tools and a user manual. Listed dimensions are 15.74 x 7.67 x 47.24 in at about 40 lb; check the current listing if you need the assembled play footprint, since it isn't spelled out separately. As with any active game, keep an eye on how it's used and follow the included manual's setup and safety guidance.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an easy game to understand and a strange one to picture until you see it: two people, seated, playing soccer with their feet across a table-sized pitch. It turns a spare bit of floor into a fast, competitive game that doesn't need a screen.
highlights: Two enclosed benches face off across a netted soccer table
Players control the ball with their feet, seated, to score
Includes gaming mat, redesigned bench legs, anthracite grey finish (listed)
Sets up with included tools in minutes; portable for home, office, beach or backyard
Each bench listed to support up to 150 kg; recommended for ages 6+
Includes table, 2 benches with nets, official ball, tools, manual

name: MOVA Self Rotating Globe, Jupiter Classic (4.5")
shortDescription: A globe that rotates on its own, powered only by ambient light, with no cords, batteries or motor noise.
description: This is Jupiter, and it just spins. The MOVA Globe floats a 4.5" sphere inside a clear acrylic shell on a frictionless bed of fluid, and rotates it using only ambient light, with no batteries, cords or visible motor. This version shows Jupiter, based on satellite imagery, with its banded clouds, storms and the Great Red Spot rendered in browns, golds and pale aqua. The listing says it needs comfortable room conditions, away from direct sunlight and strong magnets, and that soft indoor lighting is enough to keep it turning. It stands about 7 inches tall on its base and weighs about 2 lb.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the kind of object people stop and stare at before they figure out how it works: a planet turning by itself on a desk, with nothing plugged in. A quiet, well-made piece of kinetic decor rather than a gadget you interact with.
highlights: Rotates on its own using only ambient light; no batteries or cords
Jupiter design based on satellite imagery, including the Great Red Spot
Floats inside a clear acrylic shell on a frictionless fluid layer
About 4.5" globe, 7" tall on its base, 2 lb
Keep away from direct sun and strong magnets, per the listing

name: MOOCCI Levitating Bulb Lamp
shortDescription: A light bulb that floats and rotates in mid-air above its base, powered wirelessly and lit from within.
description: The bulb isn't sitting on anything. The MOOCCI Levitating Bulb Lamp holds a minimalist glass bulb above a resin, wood-look base using magnetic levitation, and powers it wirelessly so it lights up and rotates 360° while it hovers. The base has a touch button for on/off, and the listing says that if power is interrupted the bulb settles safely back onto the base rather than falling. Getting the bulb to balance and float takes a bit of practice finding the lift point, per the listing. It measures about 5" x 5" x 5" and weighs about 1.1 lb.
whyWeLikeIt: Balancing the bulb over its base and watching it settle into a slow hover is most of the fun here; the glow afterward is a bonus. It's a small, conversation-starting piece for a desk or shelf, and an easy gift for someone who likes objects that shouldn't quite work.
highlights: Bulb floats and rotates 360° above its base via magnetic levitation
Wireless power transmission; touch on/off button on the base
Bulb settles back onto the base if power is interrupted (listed)
Resin base with a wood-like textured finish

name: Wood Trick Cyber Hand 3D Wooden Puzzle
shortDescription: A 586-piece wooden puzzle that builds into a mechanical robotic hand you can wear and move with your own fingers.
description: You build it, then you wear it. The Wood Trick Cyber Hand is a 586-piece wooden mechanical model that assembles, without glue, into a robotic-looking hand with moving joints. Once built, it fits over your hand with slots for your fingers, so you can perform handshakes, high-fives, thumbs-up and other gestures, or use it as a stand for a phone or tablet. The listing lists dimensions of 5.43 x 18.3 x 6.77 in and estimates about 8 hours to assemble, describing it as suited to experienced puzzle builders. It comes with an illustrated step-by-step guide.
whyWeLikeIt: Most 3D wooden puzzles end up as static display pieces. This one becomes a wearable, moving mechanism you control with your own hand, which makes the build itself feel like the whole point rather than a means to a shelf object.
highlights: 586-piece wooden mechanical puzzle, no glue required
Wearable: fits over your hand with moving finger joints
Performs gestures like handshakes, high-fives, thumbs-up
Can double as a phone or tablet stand
About 8 hours to assemble; illustrated guide included

name: Eilik DQ Desktop Companion Robot
shortDescription: A small desktop robot with expressive animated reactions to touch, no app or setup required.
description: Eilik DQ is a character in the Eilik line of desktop companion robots: a desert-explorer-themed edition with its own startup animation, four pieces of explorer gear and a shooting mini-game against an in-universe boss character. The listing describes it as reacting to touch and interaction with expressive animations and a personality that comes through the more you handle it, and says it's ready to interact right out of the box with no complicated setup. Bring it near other Eilik robots and the listing says they react to each other. It's positioned as a gift for kids and adults, and the wider Eilik line has optional add-ons (an AI Station and other characters) that expand what it can do.
whyWeLikeIt: It doesn't try to be a voice assistant or a smart-home hub, it's just a small robot with a face full of personality that reacts when you touch it. That single-mindedness is what makes it a fun object to have on a desk rather than another gadget to configure.
highlights: Desert-explorer character in the Eilik desktop robot line
Expressive animations that react to touch, out of the box
Includes explorer gear and a shooting mini-game vs. a boss character
Reacts to other Eilik robots when placed nearby (listed)

name: RayCue Maclock WB-8 Retro Pixel Alarm Clock
shortDescription: A miniature 1984-computer-shaped alarm clock with a pixel display for time, calendar and room temperature.
description: A tiny vintage computer that happens to be a clock. The RayCue Maclock WB-8 is shaped like an early-1980s all-in-one PC, with a high-contrast pixel LCD that shows time, calendar, day and room temperature together, plus a hidden pixel smiley animation at startup. There are five alarm modes (off, one-time, weekdays, weekends, daily) set with a top touch dial, and a bottom dial for brightness. The listing includes a floppy-disk-shaped prop, retro stickers, a USB-C cable and a manual; inserting the floppy-disk sticker triggers a mock boot animation. The listing also notes the temperature reading pauses briefly while the backlight is on, to avoid heat interference, and recommends turning the backlight off for an accurate reading.
whyWeLikeIt: It miniaturizes a whole era of computer design into a clock small enough to sit next to a keyboard, complete with a fake boot-up sequence. A genuinely funny, well-made desk object for anyone who grew up around or loves that look.
highlights: 1984-computer-shaped alarm clock with a pixel LCD
Shows time, calendar, day and room temperature at once
Floppy-disk prop triggers a mock boot animation
USB-C powered; cable, stickers and manual included

name: ATuMan Mooda Smart Thermometer Hygrometer Clock
shortDescription: A retro pixel-display thermometer and hygrometer with a small animated character and a mechanical joystick.
description: The ATuMan Mooda reads room temperature and humidity and shows them on a retro pixel screen, alongside a second small pixel display with an animated character whose expression is meant to react to conditions. A mechanical joystick lets you flick through different pixel expressions and views. The listing gives a temperature accuracy of about ±2°C over 14.2°F-140°F, and humidity accuracy of about ±7% RH over 0-99% RH, with readings refreshing every 30 seconds. It has an 800mAh rechargeable battery charged over USB, measures about 6.1 x 2.7 x 1.1 in, and can sit on a desk or mount on a wall. The listing notes the unit runs warm while charging and recommends letting it sit for 30-60 minutes after a full charge before relying on its readings.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a small, playful way to keep an eye on a room's temperature and humidity instead of a plain LCD readout, with a joystick to flip through pixel-art views. A fun desk gadget for anyone who likes retro screens.
highlights: Retro pixel display with an animated character and mechanical joystick
About 6.1 x 2.7 x 1.1 in; desk or wall use

name: LaMetric TIME Wi-Fi Smart Clock
shortDescription: A Wi-Fi pixel display that runs as a clock, weather readout, social-media counter and notification board.
description: The LaMetric TIME is a 37x8 LED pixel display that connects over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and runs whatever "app" you assign it: a clock face, weather, timers, RSS news, social-media subscriber counts, cryptocurrency rates, or a scrolling Cinema-Light-Box-style message, with thousands of clockfaces available or the option to build your own. It has a built-in speaker for internet radio and Spotify streaming with a visual equalizer, and the listing lists integrations with Sonos, Netatmo, Bosch, Siemens, Neff, Gaggenau, Thermador, Philips Hue, LIFX and WeMo, plus voice control through Amazon Echo or Google Assistant. It measures about 7.9 x 2.4 in and is corded.
whyWeLikeIt: It's less a clock than a small programmable notification board: the same box can show the time, the weather, a follower count or your own scrolling message, depending on what you point it at. A distinctive way to bring live information into a desk setup without a screen.
highlights: Runs as a clock, weather display, counters or scrolling messages
Built-in speaker for internet radio and Spotify

name: Marshall Emberton III Portable Speaker, Cream
shortDescription: A rugged, IP67-rated portable Bluetooth speaker with Marshall's signature sound and over 32 hours of playtime.
description: The Marshall Emberton III is a compact portable Bluetooth speaker built with Marshall's Dynamic Loudness, which the listing describes as adjusting tonal balance to keep the sound full at any volume, plus a True Stereophonic mode for a wider, multi-directional soundstage. It's rated IP67 for dust and water resistance, and the listing states it can be submerged in 1 m (3 ft) of water for up to 30 minutes. Listed battery life is over 32 hours on a charge, and it has a built-in microphone for hands-free calls. This is the Cream colorway. Output is listed at 20 watts with Bluetooth connectivity.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a small, tough speaker from a brand known for its sound rather than its gadget features, built to survive being genuinely taken outside, to the beach or in the shower, not just carried between rooms.
highlights: Marshall Dynamic Loudness and True Stereophonic sound
IP67 dust and water resistant; submersible to 1 m for up to 30 min (listed)
32+ hours of playtime on a charge

name: 8BitDo Retro Cube 2 Speaker
shortDescription: A retro console-inspired Bluetooth speaker with a D-pad control layout and a built-in wireless charging dock.
description: The 8BitDo Retro Cube 2 takes the look of a classic console and turns it into a portable Bluetooth speaker, with dual drivers for stereo sound and D-pad-style controls on top. It connects over Bluetooth 5.3, 2.4G wireless or wired USB, switches between Music and Gaming sound modes with one press, and has an integrated wireless charging dock built into the base. The listing lists a 2000mAh battery, a built-in microphone, and a USB-C adapter included, and positions it for a desk, travel or gaming setup.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a speaker that looks like it belongs next to a retro console rather than a generic Bluetooth speaker shape, and the wireless charging dock built into the base means it can double as a phone stand between uses.
highlights: NES-inspired retro cube design with D-pad controls
True stereo sound; Music/Gaming mode switch
Bluetooth 5.3, 2.4G wireless or wired USB connections
2000mAh battery, built-in microphone, USB-C adapter included

name: Crosley Rondo Portable Bluetooth Speaker
shortDescription: A retro-styled portable Bluetooth speaker built for desk decor as much as sound.
description: The Crosley CR3039A Rondo is a small retro-look Bluetooth speaker with a built-in 3-watt driver and microphone for hands-free calls. It runs on a rechargeable lithium-ion battery, listed at up to 27 hours of listening at 50% volume, and charges via micro-USB in under 6 hours. Alongside Bluetooth streaming, it plays from USB and microSD, so it works as a standalone music player too. The design draws on Crosley's history of vintage-look audio products, made in the Tourmaline colorway shown here.
whyWeLikeIt: It's built to look good sitting out on a desk or shelf as much as to sound good, in a retro shape that doesn't read as another plain Bluetooth puck.
highlights: Retro-styled portable Bluetooth speaker with built-in microphone
Up to 27 hours of listening at 50% volume (listed)
Charges via micro-USB in under 6 hours
Also plays from USB and microSD

name: WSTER Cyberpunk Truck Bluetooth Speaker
shortDescription: A pickup-truck-shaped Bluetooth speaker with RGB wheel lights, a color screen and movable wheels.
description: The WSTER WS-580L is a Bluetooth speaker built into a geometric, pickup-truck-shaped body, with movable wheels, a front LED light strip, RGB wheel lighting and a small color display screen. It connects over Bluetooth 5.4 and also plays via FM radio, USB, a TF card or an AUX cable, has a built-in microphone for hands-free calls, and can pair with a second WS-580L unit over TWS for wider stereo sound. The listing also mentions a remote selfie control function. Output is listed at 15 watts.
whyWeLikeIt: It's more desk display than plain speaker: RGB wheels, a light strip and a little screen, shaped like a truck that happens to play music. A playful pick for a gaming or cyberpunk-styled setup.
highlights: Pickup-truck-shaped Bluetooth speaker with movable wheels
RGB wheel lighting, front LED strip and a color display screen
Bluetooth 5.4, FM radio, USB, TF card and AUX playback
TWS pairing with a second unit for wider stereo

name: Stylophone Original Pocket Synthesizer
shortDescription: A pocket-sized electronic synthesizer played by sliding a stylus across a metal keyboard.
description: The Stylophone is played by tapping and sliding its connected stylus along a touch-sensitive metal surface, where each segment plays a different note across 3 octaves, with an optional vibrato effect. The listing traces it back to its original 1968 release and its analog sound, and notes it's been used by musicians including David Bowie and The White Stripes. It's under 12 cm wide, runs on 3 AA batteries, and has a built-in speaker plus a headphone socket. A 3.5mm stereo cable lets you route it into a computer's line input to record or process the sound further.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a genuinely playable instrument that fits in a coat pocket, with that unmistakable buzzy analog tone. An easy, low-pressure way for anyone to make music, whether it's their first instrument or their tenth.
highlights: Pocket-sized analog synthesizer played with a stylus
Runs on 3 AA batteries; under 12 cm wide

name: Otamatone Electronic Synthesizer Toy, Black
shortDescription: A note-shaped Japanese electronic instrument you play by sliding your fingers along its stem and squeezing its face.
description: The Otamatone is an electronic musical toy from Japan's Maywa Denki studio, played by sliding your fingers along its stem to change pitch and squeezing its "cheeks" for vibrato. The listing describes it as sold globally and enjoyed across ages, with a compact size of about 10.6 in (27 cm) for portability. It runs on 3 AAA batteries, not included, and the listing frames it as easy to pick up for a first try and expressive enough for people with more musical experience.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an instrument that's genuinely funny to look at and play, and the sliding-pitch design means anyone can make a recognizable tune within a minute of picking it up. A reliable icebreaker of a gift.
highlights: Slide-pitch electronic instrument from Maywa Denki
Compact and portable, about 10.6 in (27 cm)

name: Heated Ice Cream Scoop, Rechargeable
shortDescription: A rechargeable electric scoop that heats up so it glides through hard ice cream straight from the freezer.
description: This scoop heats its zinc-alloy head to one of 3 levels (120°F/140°F/160°F, per the listing) so it moves through hard ice cream, gelato or sorbet without waiting for it to soften. An LED display shows the heat setting and battery status, and the listing says it reaches its highest temperature in about 90 seconds. It's cordless, powered by a built-in 2500mAh battery that recharges over USB, and has a 10-minute auto shutoff. The listing lists a 2.05 oz scoop capacity, a non-stick head, an IP67-rated waterproof body, and a drip-proof stand.
whyWeLikeIt: It solves the specific annoyance of a scoop that won't go through frozen-solid ice cream, and does it with a heated head instead of the usual run-it-under-hot-water routine. A small, satisfying kitchen gadget and an easy gift.
highlights: 3 heat levels (120°F/140°F/160°F, listed) for hard ice cream
LED display for heat and battery status

name: Genuine Fred PIZZA BOSS 3000 Pizza Cutter
shortDescription: A pizza cutter shaped like a circular saw, with a laser-etched stainless steel blade and a removable safety shield.
description: The Pizza Boss 3000 is a pizza wheel built to look like a handheld circular saw: an engineering-grade plastic body around a laser-etched, food-safe stainless steel blade. The blade has a removable shield for easier cleaning, and the listing recommends hand washing. It measures about 4.5 x 4 in and weighs about 7 oz, and comes packaged in a color window box.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a routine kitchen tool into a small joke every time you use it: cutting a pizza with something that looks like it belongs in a toolbox. A cheap, easy gift that gets a reaction.
highlights: Pizza cutter shaped like a circular saw
Removable blade shield for easy cleaning (hand wash recommended)
Comes in a color window box, ready to gift

name: Al Dente Red Singing Floating Pasta Timer
shortDescription: A mobster-shaped timer that floats in the pasta pot and sings a different tune at 3, 7, 9 and 11 minutes.
description: Al Dente Red is a floating timer shaped like a little mobster figure: drop it into the pot with your pasta, and as the water boils it whistles a different melody at four points, "That's Amore" at 3 minutes, the Godfather theme at 7 minutes, Tarantella Napoletana at 9 minutes and Prisoners' Choir at 11 minutes, so you can match the tune to the shape of pasta you're cooking. The listing says it floats in both cold and boiling water and is designed and made in Germany. It's a genuinely small object, about 2.68 x 2.04 x 3.94 in.
whyWeLikeIt: It replaces glancing at a phone timer with an actual song coming out of the pot, tuned to how long your pasta needs. A silly, well-made kitchen object and a fun gift for anyone who cooks a lot of pasta.
highlights: Floats in the pot and sings at 3, 7, 9 and 11 minutes
Four different melodies, one per timing
Floats in cold and boiling water (listed)

name: LuvLink Infinity Voice Friendship Lamp, Set of Two
shortDescription: Two paired lamps: touch one anywhere in the world and its partner lights up the same color for the other person.
description: The LuvLink Infinity Voice lamp is sold as a set of two: place your hand in one lamp's ring and both it and its paired lamp swirl the same color, wherever the second lamp is in the world. The LuvLink app lets you record and send short voice messages between the pair, and set up a color code for specific meanings like "goodnight" or "I miss you." The listing lists an improved Bluetooth setup and extended Wi-Fi range on this v2 version, no subscription required, and USB power. Lamps can be mixed and matched with other LuvLink designs, and more than two can be linked together, per the listing.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a small, ongoing way to stay present with someone far away, a color instead of a text, that shows up as a physical object in the room rather than a notification. A genuinely thoughtful gift for a long-distance relationship, a college student, or family overseas.
highlights: Set of two: touch one lamp, its pair lights the same color anywhere
Send short voice messages between the pair via the app
Set a custom color code for specific messages
Mix and match with other LuvLink lamp designs (listed)

name: Victrola Willow Retro Wood Bluetooth Radio
shortDescription: A compact wood-finished tabletop radio with analog AM/FM dials and Bluetooth streaming.
description: The Victrola Willow pairs a vintage wood-finished body with modern playback: an analog AM/FM rotary dial alongside Bluetooth streaming from a phone, tablet or laptop. Built-in stereo speakers handle both the radio and streamed audio, and separate bass and treble knobs let you shape the sound; the volume knob doubles as the power switch. It measures about 9.5 x 6.3 x 4.9 in and is shown here in Espresso. The listing frames it as part of Victrola's 115-year history in audio design.
whyWeLikeIt: It looks like a piece of 1950s furniture but streams from a phone just as easily as it tunes into FM, so it fits a desk or shelf without looking like the rest of your electronics.
highlights: Analog AM/FM tuning plus Bluetooth streaming
Built-in stereo speakers; bass and treble knobs
Volume knob doubles as the power switch
About 9.5 x 6.3 x 4.9 in; Espresso wood finish

name: The Original Rubik's Connected 3x3 Smart Cube
shortDescription: An official Rubik's Cube with Bluetooth and a companion app that tracks your moves and times your solves.
description: The Rubik's Connected is the classic Rubik's Cube with Bluetooth built in, paired to a free companion app that tracks your moves in real time. The listing describes a step-by-step academy that teaches solving the cube in 7 steps, mini-games, solve-time stats, and online battles against other cubers on a global leaderboard. Setup is charge the cube, install the app, and turn on Bluetooth; on Android, location services may also need to be enabled. It's built as a magnetic speed cube under the smart electronics.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns the most famous puzzle in the world into something you can actually track progress on: real solve times, a guided path from never-solved-it to fast, and battles against strangers online. A satisfying gift for anyone who's always meant to learn.
highlights: Official Rubik's Cube with Bluetooth and a free companion app
Real-time move tracking and solve-time stats
7-step guided academy to learn to solve it
Mini-games and online battles with a global leaderboard

name: OLEOCA Tabletop Pinball Machine, Space
shortDescription: A compact tabletop pinball machine with a pull-back launcher, flippers, and space-themed lights and sound.
description: The OLEOCA Tabletop Pinball Machine shrinks a pinball table down to desktop size: pull back the launcher, work the flippers, and aim past UFO-themed targets and obstacles to score in marked point zones, with electronic sound and light effects. The listing describes it as a 1-2 player game with easy-to-read scoring, suction-cup feet to hold it steady on smooth tables, and built-in storage for the balls. It's compact and lightweight, with a carry handle, and a clear cover keeps balls in play.
whyWeLikeIt: It packs the physical, satisfying parts of pinball, flippers, launcher, that ball-in-play tension, into something the size of a placemat. A fun addition to a game shelf or a desk, and an easy pick-up-and-play gift.
highlights: Pull-back launcher, working flippers, sound and light effects
Space/UFO theme with marked scoring zones
Compact and portable with a carry handle

name: Crosley Cruiser Plus Record Player, Tourmaline
shortDescription: A portable 3-speed suitcase turntable with built-in speakers and two-way Bluetooth.
description: The Crosley Cruiser Plus is a belt-drive turntable that plays 33 1/3, 45 and 78 RPM records, with a cueing lever and adjustable pitch control. It has two-way Bluetooth: stream your phone's music through its built-in stereo speakers, or send the turntable's own sound out to a wireless speaker. There's an aux input, an RCA output for a stereo system, and a headphone jack for private listening. Listed contents are the turntable, a 45 RPM adapter, an AC adapter and an instruction manual, in a portable suitcase body with a carry handle. This is the Tourmaline colorway.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a genuinely portable record player, not just a retro-styled Bluetooth speaker, in a suitcase shape that still looks right on a shelf. A nice way into vinyl, or a nostalgic gift for someone who already has records.
highlights: Two-way Bluetooth: stream in, or send audio out
Aux input, RCA output, headphone jack
Portable suitcase design with carry handle
Includes 45 RPM adapter and AC adapter

name: FiayaCom Bluetooth Retro Rotary Phone
shortDescription: A vintage rotary-style desk phone that connects to your smartphone over Bluetooth to make calls and play music.
description: This is a rotary-dial phone body wired for a modern phone: it pairs to your smartphone over Bluetooth so you can make and receive calls through it, hands-free, or use it as a Bluetooth speaker for music. There are no phone cords to run, since it charges over USB and runs cordless, and the listing says it reconnects automatically when you're back in range. Holding the * key activates your phone's voice assistant through the handset, for things like placing a call or setting an alarm. It's finished in black with gold trim, at about 6 x 6 x 10 in.
whyWeLikeIt: It looks like a prop from an old film and works like a real accessory: a rotary phone on the desk that actually rings your calls and plays your music over Bluetooth. A genuinely surprising piece of desk decor.
highlights: Bluetooth pairing for calls and music through the handset
Reconnects automatically when back in range (listed)
Voice assistant activation via the * key
Vintage black-and-gold rotary design, about 6 x 6 x 10 in

name: AeroGarden Bounty, Black
shortDescription: A Wi-Fi and Alexa-compatible hydroponic indoor garden that grows herbs and vegetables year-round with no soil.
description: The AeroGarden Bounty grows up to 9 plants, as tall as 24 in, hydroponically: no soil, no mess, just pre-seeded pods dropped into a water reservoir. The listing lists a 3-step water level indicator, Wi-Fi connectivity and Alexa compatibility, and 40-watt energy-efficient LED grow lights that automatically turn on and off and are tuned for growth. The system reminds you when to add water and liquid plant food. Listed contents are a seed pod kit with pre-seeded pods, liquid plant food, a quick start guide and a 6-inch trellis. This is the Black colorway.
whyWeLikeIt: It takes the guesswork out of growing herbs indoors: no soil to manage, a light that schedules itself, and reminders instead of a plant you have to remember to check on. A genuinely useful, low-effort way to have fresh herbs on a counter.
highlights: Hydroponic (no-soil) indoor garden, up to 9 plants
Wi-Fi and Alexa compatible; 3-step water level indicator
40W LED grow lights that schedule themselves
Reminds you when to add water and plant food
Includes pre-seeded pod kit, plant food and a 6-in trellis

name: Click & Grow Smart Garden 3, Sage
shortDescription: A self-watering indoor herb garden with a grow light and patented smart soil pods you just drop in.
description: The Click & Grow Smart Garden 3 uses the brand's patented Smart Soil pods instead of a hydroponic reservoir: drop in the included plant pods, fill the water tank, and plug in the built-in LED grow light. The listing lists over 50 pre-seeded plant pod varieties, from basil and cilantro to lavender, wild strawberries and chili peppers, plus seedless pods if you want to grow something of your own choosing. It comes with 3 basil pods to start, and the listing frames it as needing no gardening experience. Grown plants can later be moved to another planter, indoors or out.
whyWeLikeIt: It's about as close to hands-off gardening as a countertop kitchen gadget gets: drop in a pod, fill the tank, and the light and soil do the rest. A well-loved, easy gift for anyone who wants fresh herbs without the upkeep.
highlights: Self-watering with patented Smart Soil pods

name: OutIn Nano Portable Espresso Machine
shortDescription: A self-heating, battery-powered espresso maker small enough to pack for travel or camping.
description: The OutIn Nano heats its own water and pulls a shot with 20-bar pressure, working with either ground coffee or NS-compatible capsules. The listing says it heats 1.7 oz of room-temperature water to about 198°F in around 200 seconds, and runs on a built-in 2500mAh battery, good for about 5 hot shots from room-temperature water or 200+ shots when you start with hot water; it also charges over USB-C, including from a 10-15W car charger. It weighs about 670 g, is made from food-grade stainless steel, and the listing notes it should travel in carry-on luggage only, not used in flight. This is the Space Gray colorway.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a real espresso shot, not instant coffee, made from a machine small enough to fit in a bag: camping, a hotel room, or a desk without a coffee machine. A genuinely surprising gadget for anyone who takes coffee seriously on the move.
highlights: Works with ground coffee or NS-compatible capsules
About 5 hot shots per charge from room-temp water (listed)
USB-C charging, including from a car charger

name: BigBlue 28W Foldable Solar Panel Charger
shortDescription: A foldable 28-watt solar panel with dual USB-C and USB-A ports for charging devices directly from sunlight.
description: The BigBlue 28W panel folds down to about 11 x 6 x 1.4 in and weighs about 1.5 lb, unfolding to charge phones, power banks, GPS units and other small electronics directly in sunlight. It has two USB-C ports and one USB-A port, each rated up to 5V/3A, for a combined output of 5V/4.8A, so it can charge more than one device at once. The listing lists an IP44 water-resistant build (the USB junction box itself is not waterproof) and notes the panel has no internal battery, so output depends on direct sunlight and stops without it; it isn't rated for laptops or power stations. Listed contents: the panel, a USB-C to USB-C cable, carabiners and a manual.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a straightforward way to keep phones and small gear charged off-grid, camping, hiking, during a power outage, without carrying a bulky power station. Folds small enough to actually pack.
highlights: 28W foldable solar panel; dual USB-C + USB-A
Combined output up to 5V/4.8A for multi-device charging
IP44 water-resistant panel (junction box is not)
No internal battery; needs direct sunlight to charge
Folds to about 11 x 6 x 1.4 in, 1.5 lb

name: Rechargeable Hand Warmers, 2-Pack
shortDescription: A pair of pocket-sized rechargeable hand warmers with five heat levels and a digital display.
description: These hand warmers use a 3000mAh battery per unit and heat up within seconds of a single button press, with 5 temperature levels listed between about 93°F and 131°F and a digital display for the current level and remaining charge. Listed runtime is 8-15 hours depending on the heat setting used. They snap together into a pair or work individually, small enough to fit a glove or a pocket, and the listing lists UL/CE/FCC safety certifications. The listing recommends charging them every few months if left unused for a long stretch.
whyWeLikeIt: They solve the specific problem of cold hands outdoors, skiing, a football game, a walk, without disposable warming packets. A small, well-reviewed travel gadget and an easy stocking-stuffer gift.
highlights: 3000mAh battery per unit; 5 heat levels (~93-131°F, listed)
Digital display for heat level and battery
8-15 hours of runtime depending on setting (listed)
Snap together as a pair or use individually

name: ULANZI VL119 RGB LED Light Wand
shortDescription: A handheld RGB light stick for video and photography, with adjustable color, brightness and color temperature.
description: The ULANZI VL119 is a 50 cm handheld tube light for video and photos, built around 114 LEDs with a CRI95+ rating for natural-looking light. The listing lists a full 0-360° hue range, 0-100% dimming, color temperature adjustable from 2500K to 9000K, and 20 preset light effects, all read on a built-in LCD display. It runs on a 3300mAh battery, listed at about 70 minutes of continuous use at full power, charges over USB-C in about 2 hours, and can be used while charging. A standard 1/4-inch mount lets it attach to a camera, tripod or light stand. It weighs about 205 g.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a compact, controllable light source for portraits, streams or product shots, useful well beyond one specific use, and small enough to keep in a bag rather than a light-stand and softbox setup.
highlights: 114 LEDs, CRI95+, full RGB hue and 2500K-9000K color temp
Built-in LCD for settings; usable while charging

name: TOMLOV P50 Handheld Digital Microscope
shortDescription: A pocket-sized digital microscope with a 2.4-inch screen for inspecting coins, jewelry, plants and small parts.
description: The TOMLOV P50 is a handheld digital microscope with a 2.4-inch IPS screen, aimed at close-up inspection of coins, stamps, jewelry, fabrics, circuit boards, watch parts and plant details. A focus wheel adjusts between fine detail and a full view, 6 built-in LEDs with 4 brightness levels light the subject, and it captures 3MP photos and 1080p video (video recording needs a microSD card, not included). The listing lists up to 120 minutes of runtime, a USB connection for viewing on a PC or Mac, and an included EVA case and lanyard. It weighs about 3 oz and measures 4.1 x 2.4 in.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns close-up inspection, coin details, plant leaves, a circuit board, into something you look at on a screen instead of squinting through an eyepiece, and it's small enough to keep in a drawer for whenever curiosity strikes.
highlights: Up to 120 minutes runtime; connects to PC/Mac
Includes EVA case and lanyard; about 3 oz

name: PhoneSoap 3 UV Phone Sanitizer & Dual Charger, White
shortDescription: A UV-C box that sanitizes a phone in a 10-minute cycle while charging it, without liquids or wipes.
description: PhoneSoap 3 is a box with dual UV-C bulbs on opposite sides, positioned to reach a phone from all angles during a 10-minute cycle: plug it in, place your phone or another small item inside, and close the lid to start. Charging ports (USB-A and USB-C) let it charge your phone at the same time, though the listing notes you supply your own USB-C wall plug. Interior dimensions are 6.88 x 3.75 x 0.6 in, large enough for bigger phone models and other small items like keys, headphones, jewelry or glasses. The listing states it kills 99.9% of germs using UV-C light, and is upfront that the results are invisible: it sanitizes surfaces with light but doesn't remove visible dirt, so it recommends wiping the phone first. White colorway.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a genuinely simple routine: phone goes in, ten minutes later it comes out charged and UV-sanitized, no wipes or sprays involved. A practical daily-use gadget as much as a novelty.
highlights: Charges via USB-A and USB-C while sanitizing
Fits larger phones and small items like keys or jewelry
Listing states 99.9% germ reduction via UV-C (does not remove visible dirt)
Includes power plug and a microfiber pad

name: Rocketbook Core Reusable Smart Notebook
shortDescription: A dot-grid notebook you write in with a special pen, scan to the cloud with an app, then wipe clean and reuse.
description: The Rocketbook Core is a reusable notebook: write with the included Pilot FriXion pen, scan each page into the Rocketbook app to send it to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneNote or another cloud service, then wipe the page clean with a damp cloth and start over. The listing describes Smart Titles and Smart Tags in the dot-grid pages for naming and organizing scanned files. This is the Letter size (8.5 x 11 in), 32 pages, with a scratch-resistant spiral-bound cover; an Executive size is also sold. Listed contents are the notebook, the FriXion pen and a cloth for wiping pages.
whyWeLikeIt: It has the feel of writing on real paper with a notebook that never runs out: every page becomes a digital file, then goes blank again. A tidy, low-waste alternative to a stack of used notebooks.
highlights: Write with the included FriXion pen; wipe clean and reuse
Scan to cloud services via the Rocketbook app
Smart Titles and Smart Tags for organizing scans
Letter size, 8.5 x 11 in, 32 dot-grid pages

name: VIVO Black 32" Standing Desk Converter
shortDescription: A height-adjustable riser that sits on an existing desk to switch between sitting and standing.
description: The VIVO DESK-V000K sits on top of an existing desk and lifts your monitor and keyboard together, so you can switch between sitting and standing without a new desk. The work surface measures 31.5 x 15.7 in, wide enough for dual monitors, with a synced keyboard tray (31.3 x 11.8 in, 10.5 in at the center) that rises and lowers with it. A touch-locking mechanism moves it through a 4.5-to-20-inch height range, rated for a 33 lb lift capacity, and the listing says assembly is minimal: attach the keyboard tray and it's ready. It's built from high-grade steel and comes with a 3-year manufacturer warranty, per the listing.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a straightforward way to add standing time to a desk you already have, without replacing the desk itself, and the synced keyboard tray means typing height stays right whichever position you're in.
highlights: 31.5 x 15.7 in surface; fits dual monitors
Synced keyboard tray rises and lowers with the desktop
4.5-20 in height range; 33 lb lift capacity

name: MOUNTRAX Cordless Neck & Shoulder Massager
shortDescription: A cordless, hands-free massager that drapes over the neck and shoulders with kneading nodes and optional heat.
description: The MOUNTRAX massager drapes over the neck and shoulders with wide arm sleeves your forearms rest inside, so your hands stay free to type, hold a book or a cup while it runs. It uses a kneading motion the listing describes as 6D shiatsu, with 2 kneading modes, 2 intensity settings and 2 heat levels, plus a 10-minute auto shutoff. It's cordless and rechargeable, listed at about 2.5 hours of use on a full charge (about 3.5 hours to charge). The listing also describes using it on the upper back, lower back, waist or legs, and the fabric cover is removable and washable. It measures about 14.1 x 12.9 x 6.7 in and weighs about 2.6 lb.
whyWeLikeIt: The wide, hands-free arm sleeves are the distinctive part: it drapes on and stays put, so it doesn't need to be held in place like a lot of neck massagers do, which makes it easier to keep using while doing something else.
highlights: Hands-free wide arm sleeves; drapes over neck and shoulders
6D shiatsu kneading, 2 modes, 2 intensities, 2 heat levels
Cordless and rechargeable, about 2.5 hours of use per charge

name: PlayShifu Orboot Earth, AR World Globe
shortDescription: A globe that comes alive through a free app: point a phone or tablet camera at it to see animals, places and facts in augmented reality.
description: Orboot Earth is a physical globe paired with a free companion app: hold a phone or tablet camera up to it and augmented-reality animals, landmarks and cultural details appear on screen, with over 1,000 facts across the listing's description. It includes interactive quizzes and games built around geography and memory, and a paper passport for collecting stickers as you "travel" to different places on the globe. The listing lists it for ages 4-10 and positions it for both home and classroom use. No screen is built into the globe itself; the AR runs through your own device's camera in the app.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a static globe into something you point a camera at and get a small AR show out of, which makes geography feel like exploration instead of a lesson. A distinctive, well-reviewed gift for a curious kid.
highlights: AR globe: point a phone/tablet camera at it via the free app
1000+ facts on animals, places and monuments (listed)
Paper passport with stickers to "travel" the globe

name: LEGO Botanicals Bonsai Tree (10281)
shortDescription: An 878-piece LEGO build of a bonsai tree in a rectangular pot on a wood-effect stand, with swappable green leaves or pink cherry blossoms.
description: Part of LEGO's adult Botanicals collection, this 878-piece set builds a bonsai tree model with a rectangular pot and a slatted wood-effect stand. It includes two sets of foliage, classic green leaves and pink cherry blossom blooms, and both can be custom arranged, so the finished tree can be restyled rather than staying one fixed display. The pink blossoms are built from tiny frog-shaped pieces. According to the listing, several elements in the collection are made from plant-based plastic produced from sustainably sourced sugarcane. Rated for ages 18+.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a build first and a decoration second: an evening with the bricks, then a bonsai that never needs watering and can switch from green to cherry blossom whenever you like. An easy gift for anyone with a desk or shelf to fill.
highlights: Bonsai with rectangular pot and slatted wood-effect stand
Two foliage options: green leaves or pink cherry blossoms
Cherry blossoms are built from tiny frog pieces
Some elements made from sugarcane-based plastic (listed)

name: BenQ ScreenBar Halo 2 Monitor Light Bar
shortDescription: A monitor-mounted light bar with an ambient backlight, an asymmetric front light angled away from the screen, and a wireless dial controller.
description: The ScreenBar Halo 2 clamps onto the top of a monitor and lights the desk from above, using a front light set at an 18° angle so it illuminates the desk without reflecting off the screen, per the listing. A wide backlight washes the wall behind the monitor. A wireless dial with a built-in display adjusts stepless brightness and color temperature from 2700K to 6500K. It turns on and off with the monitor, can adjust brightness to ambient light, and remembers a favorite setting. The clamp fits monitors 0.17-2.36 in. thick, including 1000R-1800R curved screens, and it runs over USB.
whyWeLikeIt: It frees the desk of a lamp entirely and makes the whole setup look intentional, with the glowing backlight behind the screen doing half the design work. The wireless dial is the detail people notice.
highlights: Front light at an 18° angle, aimed away from the screen
Wide ambient backlight behind the monitor
Auto on/off with monitor; ambient auto-dimming

name: Atari 2600+ Console & CX40+ Joystick
shortDescription: A modern re-creation of the Atari 2600 with HDMI output, a woodgrain finish, a replica joystick and a 10-games-in-1 cartridge.
description: The Atari 2600+ reworks the original console with HDMI output, USB power and multiple screen resolutions, while keeping the woodgrain shell and the switch feel of the original. Its cartridge slot is backwards compatible with hundreds of original Atari 2600 and 7800 games, per the listing. The box includes a CX40+ joystick recreated at the original size and layout, and a 10-in-1 cartridge with Adventure, Combat, Dodge 'Em, Haunted House, Maze Craze, Missile Command, RealSports Volleyball, Surround, Video Pinball and Yars' Revenge. An HDMI cable and USB power cable are included; a USB wall adapter is not.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the real cartridge experience rather than an emulator box, so old cartridges from a closet or a thrift store actually work. The woodgrain looks great under a TV.
highlights: 10-in-1 cartridge incl. Adventure and Missile Command

name: KODAK EKTAR H35 Half Frame Film Camera, Sage
shortDescription: A pocket-size, focus-free 35mm film camera that shoots half frames, so a 36-exposure roll yields around 72 photos.
description: The EKTAR H35 is a reusable 35mm point-and-shoot that exposes half a frame per shot, which roughly doubles the photos per roll: a 36-exposure roll yields around 72 half-frame images, per the listing. It's focus-free and designed to be simple for people new to film, with a built-in flash switched on by turning the silver ring around the lens. It weighs about 100 g and measures 4.33 x 1.77 x 2.56 in. Film and the AAA battery are not included. This listing is the sage color.
whyWeLikeIt: Film photography with half the cost per shot and none of the fiddly settings, in a camera small enough to live in a jacket pocket on a trip. The sage body is a nice touch.
highlights: Film and AAA battery not included

name: Tamagotchi Paradise, Orange Tropics
shortDescription: The newest Tamagotchi, with a zoom dial for caring for your Tama at different scales, 50+ characters to raise, and device-to-device play.
description: Tamagotchi Paradise adds a dial that zooms from cell level out to space for different care and play activities: cleaning, feeding, mini games and a LAB mode shop. Depending on how it's raised, a Tama can grow into over 50 characters across 12 species, and breeding carries traits to the next generation, per the listing. Two devices can connect to see how Tamas interact and play games with or against each other. Play starts in the Tropics field, with Glacier and Forest fields unlockable. This Orange Tropics version has a pink shell with orange top, dial and buttons. It needs 2 AAA batteries (not included) and is listed for ages 6+.
whyWeLikeIt: The 90s virtual pet, rebuilt with a zoom dial and much more to do. A pocket-sized gift that hits nostalgia and novelty at the same time.
highlights: Zoom dial from cell level to space
Connect two devices to interact and play

name: Sunnytech Hot Air Stirling Engine Model with LED (SC001)
shortDescription: A working hot-air Stirling engine: an alcohol burner heats the glass cylinder, the flywheel spins, and a small generator lights a multicolor LED.
description: This desk-size Stirling engine runs on heat from its alcohol burner: fill it with alcohol, light it, let the flame heat the glass cylinder for about 60-120 seconds, then give the flywheel a gentle push, per the listing. As it runs, it generates electricity that powers an attached multicolor LED. The base is brushed aluminum alloy, the frame is CNC-finished, the flywheel is aluminum alloy and the connecting rod is laser-cut stainless steel. Spare glass tubes and an O-ring are included. Alcohol fuel is not described as included.
whyWeLikeIt: A real heat engine you can watch run on your desk, turning a small flame into motion and light. It's a physics lesson and a conversation piece in one.
highlights: Runs on heat from an alcohol burner
Drives a small generator that lights a multicolor LED
Spare glass tubes and O-ring included
Ignite, wait ~60-120 s, push the flywheel

name: Govee RGBIC Neon Rope Light 2, 9.8ft
shortDescription: A flexible smart neon rope you bend into your own shapes, with 64 preset RGBIC effects and app, Matter, Alexa and Google Assistant control.
description: Govee's second-generation neon rope light is a 9.8 ft flexible LED tube you shape with bendable mounting clips to draw lines, outlines or words on a wall. The listing lists 64 preset RGBIC lighting effects and a shape-mapping feature in the Govee Home app that uses your phone camera to recognize the shape and apply effects across its segments. It works with Matter, Alexa and Google Assistant; 5 GHz Wi-Fi is not supported. Govee says the material is 14% more flexible and softer than the previous version. For indoor use.
whyWeLikeIt: It lets you draw with light on a wall instead of just sticking a strip behind something, which is why it shows up in so many gaming rooms and bedrooms. Shape mapping makes custom designs actually animate properly.
highlights: Shape mapping via phone camera in the app
Matter, Alexa, Google Assistant (2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only)

name: Dash Mini Waffle Maker, Red
shortDescription: A 4-inch personal waffle maker with a nonstick surface and an indicator light, compact enough for dorms and small kitchens.
description: The Dash Mini Waffle Maker makes one 4-inch waffle at a time on a nonstick cooking surface, with an indicator light to show when it's ready to use, per the listing. It's a 350-watt, 120-volt appliance that measures 6.3 x 4.8 x 2.8 in. and weighs about 1.1 lb, so it stores in a drawer or cupboard. A recipe booklet is included. This listing is the red color.
whyWeLikeIt: Small, cheap and absurdly popular for a reason: it turns waffles, hash browns or quick treats into a two-minute thing. An easy under-$25 gift.

name: Ooni Karu 12 Multi-Fuel Outdoor Pizza Oven
shortDescription: A portable outdoor pizza oven that runs on wood or charcoal (or gas with a separate burner), reaching 950°F and cooking a 12-inch pizza in about 60 seconds.
description: The Karu 12 burns real wood or charcoal out of the box, and can run on gas with the Ooni Gas Burner attachment, sold separately. According to the listing it's ready in about 15 minutes, reaches 950°F, and cooks a 12-inch stone-baked pizza in around 60 seconds. It weighs 26.4 lb, and the legs fold down and the chimney comes off for transport. A redesigned fuel tray is built to maximize airflow. It includes a pizza stone.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the step from 'homemade pizza' to actual pizzeria-style crust, in a size that fits on a patio table. A serious gift for anyone who already makes their own dough.
highlights: Wood or charcoal out of the box; gas with separate burner

name: Hatch Restore 3 Sunrise Alarm & Sound Machine, Putty
shortDescription: A bedside sunrise alarm, reading light and sound machine with 80+ sleep sounds and a dimmable clock, controlled through the Hatch Sleep app.
description: Restore 3 combines a sunrise alarm (light that gradually brightens in the morning), a bedside light and a sound machine with over 80 sleep sounds, per the listing. The clock display is dimmable so the room can stay dark. Routines pairing light and audio are set up in the Hatch Sleep app over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The purchase includes a 30-day free trial of the Hatch+ subscription for new subscribers; after the trial it costs $5.99/month or $59.99/year and can be canceled. This listing is the putty color.
whyWeLikeIt: It replaces a phone alarm with light that brightens gradually and a single device on the nightstand for sounds and reading light. The fabric-and-putty look fits a bedroom better than most gadgets.

name: Loop Experience 2 Earplugs, Black
shortDescription: Reusable filtered earplugs that lower volume while keeping sound clear, rated 17 dB SNR, with four tip sizes and a keychain case.
description: Loop Experience 2 earplugs are designed for concerts, festivals and other loud places: they lower volume with 17 dB (SNR) of filtered noise reduction while aiming to keep sound clear, and the listing describes them as certified hearing protection. The box includes four sets of silicone ear tips (XS, S, M, L; M comes pre-installed) and a keychain carry case. They're reusable and easy to clean.
whyWeLikeIt: They look like jewelry instead of foam plugs, and they take the edge off a concert, a flight or a loud bar without muffling everything. The keychain case means they're actually with you when you need them.
highlights: 4 ear tip sizes: XS, S, M, L

name: WOLFBOX MegaFlow 50 Electric Air Duster
shortDescription: A rechargeable electric air duster that replaces canned air, spinning up to 110,000 RPM with 3 speed settings and 4 nozzles.
description: The MegaFlow 50 is a handheld, rechargeable blower meant as a reusable alternative to disposable cans of compressed air. According to the listing its fan reaches up to 110,000 RPM, with three speed settings and four nozzles for keyboards, PCs, electronics, household cleaning and cars. It weighs about 0.45 lb, recharges over USB-C in about 3.5 hours, and runs up to 240 minutes on the lowest setting. A lanyard is included.
whyWeLikeIt: Canned air runs out, gets freezing cold and ends up in the trash; this just recharges. Keyboards, vents and PC fans are the obvious targets.
highlights: Up to 240 min on lowest setting

name: UGEARS Astronomer Table Clock with Tourbillon
shortDescription: A 338-piece wooden mechanical model kit that builds into a working table clock with a visible tourbillon, assembled without glue.
description: The Astronomer is a UGEARS 3D wooden puzzle that builds into a fully working table clock. It includes 338 wooden parts and instructions, and the pieces fit together without glue or special tools, per the listing. Its centerpiece is a tourbillon, a rotating escapement mechanism shown in motion on the front of the clock. It's listed for adult builders.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a long, satisfying build that ends as a clock you can watch tick, with the tourbillon turning in plain sight. A good gift for anyone who likes mechanisms more than screens.
highlights: No glue or special tools needed

name: MEATER Plus Wireless Smart Meat Thermometer, Honey
shortDescription: A fully wire-free meat thermometer probe with dual sensors, a Bluetooth repeater in its bamboo charger, and guided cooks in the MEATER app.
description: The MEATER Plus is a single wireless probe that sits in the meat with no cables. It has two sensors: one for internal meat temperature (up to 212°F) and one for ambient temperature (up to 527°F), per the listing. Its bamboo charging block has a built-in Bluetooth repeater to extend range. The MEATER app gives step-by-step guided cooks, alerts and estimated finish times. A 5-minute charge gives about 2 hours of cook time, and the probe is dishwasher safe. The box includes the probe, the bamboo charger and a AAA battery.
whyWeLikeIt: No wire snaking out of the oven or grill lid, and a phone alert instead of guessing. It's one of those gadgets people buy once and then give to everyone who grills.
highlights: Dual sensors: meat up to 212°F, ambient up to 527°F
Guided cooks and estimated finish in app

name: Dash Rapid Egg Cooker, 7 Eggs, Black
shortDescription: A countertop egg cooker for up to 7 soft, medium or hard-boiled eggs, with poaching and omelette trays and auto shut-off.
description: The Dash Rapid Egg Cooker steams up to seven eggs at once to soft, medium or hard-boiled, without a pot of boiling water, per the listing. A poaching tray and an omelette bowl handle poached eggs and quick frittatas. A thermal sensor shuts it off and sounds a chime when the water has evaporated. It includes a boiling tray, poaching tray, omelette bowl, and a measuring cup with an egg-piercing pin, all of which nest inside for storage. It measures 7.5 x 7.5 x 6 in. This listing is the black color.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes eggs something you set and walk away from, which is exactly what a weekday breakfast needs. A tiny footprint for how often it gets used.
highlights: Up to 7 eggs: soft, medium or hard-boiled

name: Nostalgia Vintage Cotton Candy Machine, Pink
shortDescription: A countertop, circus-styled cotton candy maker that spins flossing sugar or hard candy into cotton candy in minutes.
description: This Nostalgia cotton candy machine warms up on the counter, then spins either flossing sugar or hard candy into cotton candy, which you collect on the included cones, per the listing. It comes with two reusable cones, a sugar scoop and an extractor head, has suction-cup feet for stability, and disassembles for cleaning. It's compatible with Nostalgia's cotton candy kits. It measures 10 x 12.5 x 11.5 in. and weighs about 5.2 lb. This listing is the pink color.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns any birthday or movie night into a small event, and the vintage cart styling means it looks fun even sitting on a shelf. Hard candy support makes it easy to experiment with flavors.
highlights: Uses flossing sugar or hard candy
2 reusable cones, sugar scoop, extractor head

name: Twelve South AirFly Pro 2 Bluetooth Adapter
shortDescription: A small Bluetooth 5.3 adapter that plugs into any headphone jack, like an airplane seat screen, so you can use AirPods or other wireless headphones, with two pairs at once.
description: AirFly Pro 2 turns a 3.5 mm headphone jack into a Bluetooth 5.3 transmitter, so audio from airplane seat screens, gym TVs or game consoles can go to AirPods or other wireless headphones. A switch flips it into receive mode to add Bluetooth to a wired speaker or stereo. It can pair two sets of headphones at once, with dedicated pairing buttons, and supports aptX HD Adaptive. According to the listing, battery life is over 25 hours.
whyWeLikeIt: It solves the 'my AirPods don't work with the airplane screen' problem for good, and the dual pairing lets two people watch the same movie on a flight. It lives in a travel pouch permanently.
highlights: Turns any 3.5 mm jack into Bluetooth 5.3

name: DJI Osmo Mobile 7 Phone Gimbal
shortDescription: A foldable 3-axis smartphone gimbal with a built-in tripod, ActiveTrack 7.0 subject tracking, and up to 10 hours of operating time.
description: The Osmo Mobile 7 stabilizes a phone on three axes for smoother video. It has an integrated foldable design with a built-in tripod, weighs about 300 g, and has an anti-slip handle. With the DJI Mimo app it supports ActiveTrack 7.0 subject tracking, ShotGuides and One-Tap Edit. The listing gives a maximum operating time of 10 hours, and it can charge a phone over USB-C. Folded, it measures 179 x 95 x 39 mm.
whyWeLikeIt: It takes shaky phone footage and makes it look deliberate, and the built-in tripod means one device covers vlogging, travel clips and group shots. It folds small enough for a daypack.
highlights: Up to 10 hours; can charge your phone

name: DJI Mini 4K Camera Drone
shortDescription: A sub-249 g camera drone with 4K video on a 3-axis gimbal, Level 5 wind resistance, GPS return-to-home and 31-minute flight time.
description: The DJI Mini 4K weighs under 249 g, which per the listing means no FAA registration or Remote ID is required for recreational use (check the FAA website for current rules). It records 4K video on a 3-axis gimbal. The listing gives Level 5 wind resistance (38 kph), takeoff at altitudes up to 4,000 m, and 31 minutes of flight per battery for this single-battery set. Beginner features include one-tap takeoff and landing, GPS Return to Home and stable hovering. The listing notes the DJI Fly app should be downloaded from DJI's website on Android.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a real gimbal-stabilized 4K drone at a size and price that makes aerial footage a casual travel habit instead of a hobby commitment. The one-tap takeoff lowers the fear factor for first-timers.
highlights: One-tap takeoff/landing, GPS Return to Home

name: Exploding Kittens Card Game, Original Edition
shortDescription: A fast card game for 2-5 players, ages 7+, where you draw until someone hits an Exploding Kitten, unless they can defuse it.
description: In Exploding Kittens, players draw cards and try to avoid drawing an Exploding Kitten, using action cards to skip turns, shuffle the deck, or defuse the kitten with items like laser pointers and catnip sandwiches. The last player standing wins. It's for 2-5 players, ages 7 and up. The Original Edition includes 56 cards illustrated by The Oatmeal, a box and instructions. The listing describes it as compact enough for travel.
whyWeLikeIt: It takes two minutes to learn, works with kids and adults at the same table, and the illustrations are genuinely funny. It fits in a bag for trips.

name: LifeStraw Personal Water Filter, Blue
shortDescription: A lightweight straw-style water filter for hiking and emergencies that filters up to 4,000 liters, per the listing.
description: LifeStraw Personal is a straw you drink through directly from a water source. According to the listing, its microfiltration membrane removes 99.999999% of waterborne bacteria and 99.999% of waterborne parasites, filters microplastics down to 1 micron, and reduces turbidity down to 0.2 microns, with claims verified against US EPA, NSF and ASTM testing protocols. It's rated for 4,000 liters (1,000 gallons), is made with BPA-free materials, and measures about 12 in. long. For each LifeStraw product purchased, the company says a school child receives safe drinking water for a school year.
whyWeLikeIt: A few ounces in a pack or glovebox that makes a stream a water source. It's the rare cheap item that belongs in every hiking bag and emergency kit.
highlights: Removes bacteria and parasites per listed lab testing

name: Matador Pocket Blanket 4.0, Slate Blue
shortDescription: A 63 x 44 in. ripstop picnic and festival blanket that packs into an attached palm-sized pouch, with corner sand pockets and integrated stakes.
description: The Pocket Blanket 4.0 opens to 63 x 44 in. (seats 2-4, per the listing) and packs down to 4.5 x 2.7 x 1.1 in. in an attached storage pouch. It's made from ripstop fabric with a waterproof coating, and has integrated stakes plus corner sand pockets to hold it down in wind. An Easy Pack fold pattern is printed on it to make refolding simpler. This listing is the slate blue color.
whyWeLikeIt: It folds to the size of a phone, so you always have somewhere to sit at a park, beach or concert without carrying a real blanket. The printed fold pattern fixes the usual repacking struggle.

name: BioLite Luci Original Solar Inflatable Lantern, Clear
shortDescription: An inflatable, collapsible solar lantern that recharges by sun or USB-C, gives up to 65 lumens, and collapses to 1 inch.
description: The Luci Original is a lightweight inflatable lantern that collapses to about 1 inch thick for storage. It has a built-in 1,000 mAh lithium-ion battery that recharges via its solar panel or USB-C, and gives up to 24 hours of light per charge, per the listing. Cool white LEDs produce up to 65 lumens. It weighs 4.4 oz (125 g), is IP67 waterproof, and is rated to withstand up to 150 lb of pressure.
whyWeLikeIt: It packs flat, charges itself in the sun, and floats, so it earns a place in a camping bin, a boat bag and a power-outage drawer at once.
highlights: Up to 24 hours of light per charge (listed)

name: Meta Quest 3S 128GB VR Headset, Gorilla Tag Bundle
shortDescription: A standalone, wireless mixed-reality headset with a Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 chip and 8GB of RAM, in an Amazon-exclusive Gorilla Tag bundle.
description: Meta Quest 3S is a standalone VR headset that needs no PC or cables. It runs on the Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 processor with 8 GB of RAM and 128 GB of storage, and can blend virtual objects with your physical room for mixed-reality play, per the listing. It has a 110-degree field of view and a battery rated for 2+ hours. This Amazon-exclusive Cardboard Monkenaut bundle adds Gorilla Tag items including the Gorilla Space Program Suit and Helmet, plus 2,000 Shiny Rocks.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the most approachable way into real VR: no PC, no wires, and mixed reality that turns the living room into part of the game. The bundle makes it a ready-made gift for a Gorilla Tag fan.
highlights: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2, 8 GB RAM, 128 GB

name: Owala FreeSip Insulated Water Bottle, 24 oz, Denim
shortDescription: A 24 oz insulated stainless-steel bottle with the FreeSip spout for either sipping through a built-in straw or swigging, and a locking push-button lid.
description: The Owala FreeSip is a 24 oz double-wall insulated stainless-steel bottle. Its patented FreeSip spout lets you sip upright through the built-in straw or tilt it back to drink from the spout opening. A push-to-open lid keeps the spout covered, and the carry loop doubles as a lock. The listing says it keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and has a wide opening for ice and cleaning. It notes the bottle is wider than standard cupholders. This listing is the denim color.
whyWeLikeIt: The two-way spout is the whole reason it took over: sip or chug from the same lid, one-handed. It's the water bottle people buy in three colors.
highlights: FreeSip spout: straw sip or tilt to swig
Push-button lid; carry loop locks it

name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite 16GB, Black
shortDescription: The newest Kindle Paperwhite with a 7-inch glare-free display, 25% faster page turns, waterproofing and up to 12 weeks of battery.
description: This Kindle Paperwhite has a 7-inch glare-free display with higher contrast and 25% faster page turns than the previous generation, per the listing. The screen can shift from white to amber for reading in bright sun or in the dark. It's waterproof, charges over USB-C, and a single charge lasts up to 12 weeks according to Amazon. There are no social media, notifications or other distracting apps. This listing is the 16 GB black model, ad-supported, without Kindle Unlimited.
whyWeLikeIt: Thousands of books in something thinner than a paperback, with a battery that outlasts the trip. It's also the easiest way to read by the pool without worrying about the device.

name: MUSICOZY Bluetooth Sleep Headphones Eye Mask, Black
shortDescription: A memory-foam eye mask with ultra-thin built-in Bluetooth 5.4 speakers, designed for side sleepers, with up to 14 hours of playback.
description: This MUSICOZY sleep mask has thin, silicone-covered Bluetooth 5.4 speakers built into a memory-foam mask with an ice-silk lining, and the listing says it's designed so side sleepers can lie on it. It charges in 1-2 hours for up to 14 hours of playback. It's meant for listening to audio while blocking light on flights, public transit or at home. This listing is the black color.
whyWeLikeIt: It merges two things people pack for every flight, an eye mask and earbuds, into one that doesn't press into your ears when you lean on a headrest.
highlights: Bluetooth 5.4 speakers built into the mask
1-2 hr charge, up to 14 hr playback (listed)

name: Solo Stove Mesa XL Tabletop Fire Pit, Ash
shortDescription: A 7-inch stainless-steel tabletop fire pit that burns wood or pellets with Solo Stove's airflow design, with a stand and carry bag.
description: The Mesa XL is a small 304 stainless-steel fire pit that sits on a table and burns wood or pellets, using a built-in pellet adapter. Its airflow design is described in the listing as keeping the fire low-smoke. It includes a stand for stable burning and a nylon carry bag, measures 7 x 7 x 8.6 in., and weighs 2.3 lb. This listing is the ash color. Intended for outdoor use.
whyWeLikeIt: A real crackling fire at table height, small enough to bring camping or set in the middle of a patio dinner. It gets the most reaction of anything here when it's lit at night.
highlights: Burns wood or pellets (pellet adapter built in)
Stand and nylon carry bag included

name: Hover Soccer Light-Up Indoor Ball
shortDescription: A rechargeable air-powered disc that floats and glides across hard floors like a soccer ball, with lights and a soft foam bumper.
description: This Ninja Blast Hover Soccer ball is an air-powered disc that floats just above smooth surfaces like wood, tile and concrete, so it glides when kicked, per the listing. It lights up during play, and a soft foam bumper protects furniture from bumps. It's rechargeable, with a charging cable included. The listing gives ages 3 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: Indoor soccer without broken lamps: the foam bumper and floating glide make it a rainy-day favorite, and the lights make it better in a dim room.
highlights: Floats and glides on hard floors

name: Codenames Board Game (2nd Edition)
shortDescription: The word-association party game where two teams' spymasters give one-word clues to find their agents on a 5x5 grid, in its new second edition.
description: In Codenames, two teams race to find their agents in a 5x5 grid of words. Each team's spymaster knows which words belong to whom and gives one-word clues plus a number. Teammates guess while avoiding the other team's agents, bystanders and the assassin, which ends the game instantly. The 2nd Edition includes revised words, refreshed art, a better insert and a streamlined rulebook, per the listing. Contents include 200 cards with 400 codenames, 40 key cards, agent tiles, bystanders, an assassin tile and a card stand.
whyWeLikeIt: It works for four people or a whole party and gets people talking immediately. The second edition is the one to buy now.
highlights: Two teams, spymasters give one-word clues
2nd Edition: revised words, new art, better insert

name: Perky-Pet Window Mount Hummingbird Feeder (217)
shortDescription: A window-mounted hummingbird feeder with an 8 oz nectar bottle, three flower-style feeding ports with bee guards, and a suction cup.
description: The Perky-Pet 217 attaches directly to a window with a suction cup (or hangs from a nail), putting hummingbirds right at the glass. It holds up to 8 oz of nectar and has three soft, flexible feeding ports inspired by hollyhock flowers, tapered to keep bees and other insects out, per the listing. The bottle is made of shatter-resistant plastic.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a window into a front-row seat for hummingbirds, which is a small daily delight for very little money.
highlights: Mounts on a window with a suction cup
Can also hang from a nail

name: Elgato Key Light Studio LED Panel
shortDescription: A 2800-lumen Wi-Fi LED panel on a desk-clamp pole, with app-controlled brightness and 2900-7000K color temperature.
description: The Elgato Key Light is a flat studio light built for desks, streaming setups and video calls. It uses 160 OSRAM LEDs behind an opal glass face for even, glare-free diffusion, outputs up to 2800 lumens and dims down to a low glow, per the listing. Color temperature adjusts from 2900K to 7000K. It connects over Wi-Fi so it can be switched on and fine-tuned from Elgato's desktop app. The box includes the light, a metal pole mount with desk clamp, a power supply and a quick start guide.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the single biggest upgrade for how you look on camera, and because it clamps to the desk it doesn't eat floor space like a softbox. App control means no reaching behind the monitor.

name: Insta360 GO 3S 4K Tiny Camera, 128GB, Midnight Black
shortDescription: A 39 g, thumb-sized 4K camera with magnetic mounting, FlowState stabilization, and an Action Pod with a 2.2-inch flip screen.
description: The GO 3S is a tiny 4K camera weighing 1.4 oz (39 g) that mounts magnetically almost anywhere for hands-free point-of-view footage. It uses FlowState stabilization and Horizon Lock to keep shots smooth and level, per the listing. The included Action Pod adds a 2.2-inch flip screen, remote control and live preview, with 140 minutes of battery life, and can charge the camera while shooting. The camera itself is IPX8 waterproof to 10 m (the Action Pod is only splash-resistant). QuickCapture, gesture control and voice control help start recording when it's out of reach. This is the 128 GB standard bundle in Midnight Black.
whyWeLikeIt: It's small enough to clip to a cap, a bike or a dog collar, which is how you get the angles a phone can't. The flip-screen pod turns it into a normal camera when you need one.
highlights: Action Pod: 2.2 in. flip screen, 140 min battery

name: Theragun Mini (3rd Gen) Massage Gun, Black
shortDescription: A pocket-size percussive massager with three attachments, three speeds, one-button control, a travel lock and Bluetooth app routines.
description: The third-generation Theragun Mini is a compact percussive massage device that the listing describes as 30% smaller, lighter and quieter than the original Mini. It has one-button control with three speeds and LED indicators, plus a travel lock so it won't switch on in a bag. Three attachments are included: the Dampener, the Standard Ball and the Thumb. It connects over Bluetooth to the Therabody app, which offers guided routines. It weighs about 0.45 kg. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the massage gun you actually bring along: small enough for a carry-on or gym bag, with a lock so it never buzzes on in transit.
highlights: 30% smaller, lighter, quieter than original Mini (listed)

name: Lily's Home 14-Inch Glass Galileo Thermometer
shortDescription: A hand-blown glass Galileo thermometer whose colored floats rise and sink with room temperature, with gold-tagged readings from 64°F to 80°F.
description: This 14-inch Galileo thermometer from Lily's Home is a hand-blown glass cylinder holding five colored glass floats. As the room temperature changes, the floats rise or sink, and the lowest floating tag shows the temperature, per the classic Galileo design. The tags are engraved and gold-plated, reading from 64°F to 80°F. The liquid inside the cylinder and floats is described as a non-toxic inert oil-hydrocarbon mixture similar to mineral oil.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a working bit of 17th-century physics that doubles as a slow, colorful display on a shelf or desk. People always ask how it works.
highlights: Floats rise and sink with temperature

name: ARZOPA 16.1" Portable Monitor Z1C
shortDescription: A 16.1-inch, 1.71 lb portable 1080p IPS monitor with a built-in metal kickstand, USB-C and mini HDMI, for a second screen anywhere.
description: The ARZOPA Z1C is a 16.1-inch 1080p IPS portable monitor with 100% sRGB color coverage, 178° viewing angles, a 1000:1 contrast ratio and a matte finish, per the listing.
