A built-in metal stand holds it in landscape or portrait, so no separate case is needed to prop it up. It weighs 1.71 lb and is 0.35 in. thin. It connects over USB-C or mini HDMI to laptops, phones and game consoles, and supports duplicate, extend and second-screen modes. Refresh rate is 60 Hz.
whyWeLikeIt: A second screen changes laptop work completely, and this one folds flat into a laptop bag. It also turns a console into a portable setup for trips.
highlights: Built-in metal kickstand; landscape or portrait

name: WalkingPad P1 Foldable Under-Desk Treadmill
shortDescription: A walking pad that folds in half for storage, with a 16.5-inch belt and speeds from 0.5 to 3.75 mph for walking while you work.
description: The WalkingPad P1 is a compact walking treadmill designed to slide under a desk, bed or sofa. It folds completely in half, cutting its stored footprint by 50%, per the listing. It has an aluminum unibody frame, a 16.5-inch-wide walking belt, and speeds adjustable from 0.5 to 3.75 mph. Unfolded it measures 56.5 x 21.5 x 5 in. and weighs 62 lb. This listing is the light gray color.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes a standing desk or a TV hour count as steps without dedicating a room to a treadmill. Folding in half is what makes it realistic for an apartment.

name: Fellow Stagg EKG Pro Electric Gooseneck Kettle, Matte Black
shortDescription: A 0.9-liter gooseneck electric kettle with to-the-degree temperature control, an LCD screen and a brew timer, built for pour-over coffee and tea.
description: The Stagg EKG Pro is Fellow's pour-over kettle: a 0.9-liter stainless-steel gooseneck with a precision spout for a steady, controlled pour. It offers to-the-degree temperature control, temperature hold, a brew timer and a high-resolution LCD screen on the base, per the listing. It's designed for pour-over coffee and tea. This listing is the matte black version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the kettle that turns pour-over into a precise ritual, and it looks like a design object on the counter. A standout gift for any coffee person.

name: AeroPress Original Coffee Press
shortDescription: The compact single-cup press that combines French press, pour-over and espresso-style brewing in about two minutes, with 50 filters included.
description: The AeroPress Original is a portable, single-cup manual coffee maker that combines elements of French press, pour-over and espresso-style brewing, per the listing. Add coffee and water, wait about 30 seconds, then press through a paper micro-filter; the whole process takes around two minutes. It gives control over brew time, temperature and grind size, and can make cold brew and espresso-style drinks for lattes. Cleanup is popping out the puck and rinsing. It includes 50 paper micro-filters and is built for travel and camping.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the cult coffee tool for a reason: cheap, nearly indestructible, easy to clean, and good enough that people pack it on trips.
highlights: Control over time, temp and grind

name: Chemex Classic 8-Cup Pour-Over Coffeemaker
shortDescription: The iconic hourglass pour-over coffeemaker in non-porous borosilicate glass with a wood collar and leather tie, sized for 8 cups.
description: The Chemex Classic is the hourglass-shaped glass pour-over coffeemaker with a wooden collar and leather tie. It's made of non-porous borosilicate glass that won't absorb odors or chemical residues, per the listing. This is the 8-cup size (Chemex measures a cup as 5 oz), with a 40 fl oz capacity. Brewed coffee can be covered and refrigerated for reheating. It uses Chemex bonded filters (FP-1, FC-100, FS-100 or FSU-100), which are not included.
whyWeLikeIt: A coffee maker that's been in design museums and still looks better on a counter than almost anything else. It makes a clean, bright cup for the whole table.

name: Nostalgia Vintage Popcorn Cart, 8 oz Kettle, Red
shortDescription: A movie-theater-style popcorn cart with an 8 oz stainless-steel kettle that pops up to 32 cups per batch, with tempered glass and a lighted interior.
description: This Nostalgia popcorn cart recreates a vintage movie-theater popcorn machine as a standalone cart. Its stainless-steel kettle holds 8 oz of kernels, has a built-in stirring system and a dual-hinged lid, and pops up to 32 cups per batch, per the listing. The kettle removes for cleaning. The windows are tempered safety glass, and the interior is lighted. It works with Nostalgia popcorn kits. The cart stands 53 inches tall (model CCP510). This listing is the red color.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a basement or living room into a home theater with one object, and the smell sells it before anyone sees it. A show-stopper for movie-night families.

name: The Original Tumbler Rolling Knife Sharpener, Wood
shortDescription: A rolling knife sharpener: a magnetic angle block holds the blade at 15° or 20° while you roll a diamond disc along the edge, then hone with a steel helix disc.
description: The Tumbler replaces whetstones with a two-part system. A magnetic angle support holds the knife at a fixed 15° or 20° angle, and you roll the handheld sharpener along the edge: one side is a diamond-plated disc for sharpening, the other a stainless-steel helix disc for honing, per the listing. It's designed for kitchen, chef, field and utility knives. This is the wood version, weighing about 1.4 lb.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes sharpening feel like a satisfying two-minute ritual instead of a skill you have to learn, and the wood-and-steel set looks good enough to leave out.

name: Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow, Jet Black
shortDescription: A memory-foam neck pillow with seat straps that attach to the headrest to stop your head falling forward, compressing to a third of its size in its case.
description: The Evolution S3 is a dual-density memory-foam travel pillow with raised side wings and an adjustable chin clasp. Its patented seat-strap system attaches to an airplane, car or office seat to keep your head from dropping forward, per the listing. It compresses to one-third of its size in the included carry case, which has a luggage clip, and the cover is washable and moisture-wicking. It fits neck sizes 12-18 inches and uses CertiPUR-US certified foam. This is the jet black color.
whyWeLikeIt: The seat straps are the whole trick: they solve the head-bob that ruins sleep on a plane. Compressing to a small case means it doesn't eat a carry-on.
highlights: Seat straps attach to the headrest

name: travel inspira Digital Luggage Scale, 110 lb
shortDescription: A hanging digital luggage scale with a backlit LCD and 110 lb capacity, for weighing a suitcase before you get to the airport.
description: This handheld suspension scale hooks onto a suitcase handle so you can lift and weigh a bag before heading to the airport. According to the listing it has a 110 lb maximum capacity, a backlit LCD display, tare function, auto shut-off and a readout accuracy of 1.6 oz. It runs on a CR2032 battery, which is included.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the cheap little thing that saves an overweight-bag fee at the check-in desk, and it weighs almost nothing in the suitcase.

name: Jetboil Flash 1.0L Fast Boil Stove, Carbon
shortDescription: A compact backpacking stove system with push-button ignition that boils 16 oz of water in about 2 minutes, packing into its own 1-liter cup.
description: The Jetboil Flash is an integrated camp stove and 1-liter insulated cooking cup. A turn-and-click igniter lights the burner without a match, and the listing gives a boil time of 16 oz of water in about 2 minutes. The cup has a color-coded, rubberized safe-touch grip, an insulated cozy, and a three-point locking connection to the burner. The stove and a 100 g JetPower fuel canister (sold separately) pack inside the cup, and the bottom cup doubles as a measuring cup or bowl. It weighs 13.12 oz. This is the carbon color.
whyWeLikeIt: Coffee or a hot meal in two minutes anywhere, from a single object that packs into itself. It's the camping upgrade people rave about after the first trip.
highlights: 1 L insulated cup with safe-touch grip

name: humangear GoToob+ Travel Bottles, 3-Pack, 1.7 oz
shortDescription: Soft silicone travel bottles with a locking cap, sized at 1.7 fl oz for TSA carry-on, in a 3-pack.
description: GoToob+ bottles are soft, squeezable travel tubes for shampoo, lotion and other liquids. Each small bottle holds 1.7 fl oz, a TSA carry-on friendly size, per the listing. The LoopLock collar twists to lock the cap closed, the contoured tube stands on its own for filling and cleaning, a textured collar area can be written on to label contents, and the loop is carabiner compatible. They're made from food-safe, BPA-free and phthalate-free material. This 3-pack is clear, green and blue.
whyWeLikeIt: No more leaking shampoo in a toiletry bag: the locking cap is the difference. They're the kind of small upgrade frequent travelers never go back from.
highlights: Stands up for filling and cleaning

name: Logitech G29 Driving Force Racing Wheel and Pedals
shortDescription: A force-feedback racing wheel with a hand-stitched leather rim, 900° rotation and pressure-sensitive pedals, for PS5, PS4, PC and Mac.
description: The G29 Driving Force is a racing wheel and pedal set for PlayStation 5, PS4, PC and Mac. It uses force feedback with helical gearing for smooth, quiet steering, and the wheel has a hand-stitched leather cover and stainless-steel paddle shifters, per the listing. Lock-to-lock rotation is 900 degrees, about two and a half turns. The pedal unit has a pressure-sensitive nonlinear brake and adjustable pedal faces. A shifter and mounts are available separately.
whyWeLikeIt: It changes racing games from button-mashing into actually driving, and it's the long-running standard for a first sim-racing setup.

name: Wingspan Board Game (Stonemaier Games)
shortDescription: The award-winning bird-collecting strategy board game with 170 illustrated bird cards, egg miniatures and a birdfeeder dice tower, for 1-5 players.
description: Wingspan is a strategy game where players attract birds to their wildlife preserves, gaining food from custom dice in a birdfeeder dice tower, laying egg miniatures and playing from 170 unique bird cards whose abilities chain together, per the listing. It won the 2019 Kennerspiel des Jahres. It plays 1-5 players in 60-90 minutes, with about 6 minutes of setup. Components include 170 bird cards, 26 bonus cards, 8 goal tiles, 103 food tokens, 75 egg miniatures and 5 wooden dice.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the board game people buy for its beauty and keep playing for the strategy. The bird art and dice tower make it a centerpiece on the table.

name: Ticket to Ride Board Game (2025 Refresh)
shortDescription: The classic cross-country train route board game, refreshed for 2025, for 2-5 players ages 8+ in 30-60 minutes.
description: In Ticket to Ride, players collect colored train cards to claim railway routes across early 20th-century North America, completing destination tickets and competing for the longest continuous route, per the listing. This is the 2025 refreshed edition from Days of Wonder. It plays 2-5 players, ages 8 and up, in about 30-60 minutes. Components include the game board, 225 plastic trains in five colors, 110 train cards, 33 tickets and scoring markers.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the gateway board game that works for family, friends and new gamers alike: easy to learn in minutes, with just enough strategy to keep going back.

name: SKLZ Pro Mini Over-the-Door Basketball Hoop
shortDescription: An over-the-door mini hoop with an 18 x 12 in. shatter-proof backboard, spring-action breakaway steel rim and a 5-inch ball.
description: The SKLZ Pro Mini hangs over a door frame on slide-on mounts with protective foam padding. It has an 18 x 12 in. clear polycarbonate shatter-proof backboard, a 9-inch spring-action breakaway steel rim and a 30-ply net, per the listing. A 5-inch indoor-safe rubber basketball is included. It weighs 3.8 lb and can be moved between doors.
whyWeLikeIt: The office, dorm or bedroom classic: a real breakaway rim on a door means actual dunks instead of paper balls into a bin.

name: PRO-SPIN Portable Ping Pong Set, 4-Player
shortDescription: A retractable ping pong net that clamps to most tables, plus 4 wood paddles, 6 balls and a zip case, turning a dining table into a game.
description: This PRO-SPIN set turns an ordinary table into a ping pong table: the retractable net clamps onto tables up to 72 in. wide and 2 in. thick, per the listing. It includes four paddles with solid wood, sponge and rubber, six ping pong balls, and a zip-up storage case. This is the red 4-player set.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the fastest way to get everyone off their phones after dinner, and the whole thing stores in a case the size of a book.
highlights: Retractable net fits tables up to 72 in. wide

name: ECOVACS WINBOT W2 PRO Omni Window Cleaning Robot
shortDescription: A robot that clings to glass and cleans windows on its own, with triple-nozzle water spray, a 6-in-1 carrying station and up to 110 minutes on battery.
description: The WINBOT W2 PRO Omni is a window-cleaning robot that attaches to glass and works across it automatically using WIN-SLAM 4.0 path planning, per the listing. Three nozzles spray water ahead of a wet cleaning cloth. It can run plugged in, or on battery for up to 110 minutes in places without an outlet like balconies. A 6-in-1 station acts as control panel, charger, stabilizer and portable storage, and the robot is app-controllable. ECOVACS lists a 12-stage safety protection system including anti-fall measures.
whyWeLikeIt: Watching a robot clean the outside of a window you can't reach is genuinely satisfying, and it handles the most-avoided chore in the house.
highlights: Clings to glass and cleans automatically
Up to 110 min on battery, or plugged in

name: LUXE Bidet NEO 120 Bidet Attachment, White
shortDescription: A non-electric bidet attachment that fits under an existing toilet seat, with a self-retracting nozzle behind a guard gate and a pressure control dial.
description: The LUXE Bidet NEO 120 installs between an existing toilet seat and bowl and connects to the toilet's water supply, with no electricity required. It uses high-pressure valves with metal-ceramic cores and steel hoses rather than plastic, per the listing. The nozzle retracts behind a guard gate after each use. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's one of the most-reviewed bathroom upgrades on Amazon because it's cheap, fits most toilets in minutes, and cuts toilet-paper use.

name: Squatty Potty Original Toilet Stool, 9-Inch, White
shortDescription: The original bathroom footstool that slides around the base of the toilet to raise your feet into a squat position, in the 9-inch height.
description: The Squatty Potty is a molded footstool that wraps around the base of a toilet, so your feet rest on it and your knees are raised into a squatting posture, per the listing. This is the 9-inch height, which the listing suggests for comfort-height toilets (16.5-18 in. from floor to bowl top) or for people with shorter legs. It's made of polyurethane plastic and cleans with soap and water.
whyWeLikeIt: The Shark Tank classic that became a bathroom staple. It tucks out of sight around the toilet when not in use.

name: Waterpik Cordless Pulse Water Flosser, White
shortDescription: A rechargeable, cordless water flosser with a 6 oz removable reservoir, 2 pressure settings and 2 tips, waterproof for shower use.
description: The Waterpik Cordless Pulse is a handheld, rechargeable water flosser that uses pulsating water to clean between teeth. It has two pressure settings (low and high), comes with two flossing tips, and has a 6 oz removable reservoir that is top-rack dishwasher safe, giving up to 45 seconds of flossing per fill, per the listing. It charges over USB (wall adapter not included) with a battery indicator, and it's waterproof for use in the shower. Waterpik holds the ADA Seal of Acceptance for its water flossers, according to the listing.
whyWeLikeIt: Cordless and waterproof means it can live in the shower or a toiletry bag instead of on the sink, which is what finally makes water flossing a habit.

name: Conair Handheld Garment Steamer, 1875W, White
shortDescription: A 1875-watt handheld steamer with a heated soleplate and creaser, ready in about 35 seconds and running up to 20 minutes per 7.3 oz tank.
description: This Conair handheld steamer uses 1875 watts to remove wrinkles from clothing, curtains and upholstery. According to the listing, it heats up in about 35 seconds and a 7.3 oz removable water tank gives up to 20 minutes of continuous steam. A heated quilted-aluminum soleplate and built-in creaser allow pressed finishes on collars and cuffs without an ironing board. It has multiple steam settings, an 8-foot cord, and three attachments: a silicone band, a bristle brush and a delicate-fabric spacer. This is the white model GS59L.
whyWeLikeIt: It's faster than setting up an ironing board and works on things an iron can't reach, like hanging curtains. The listing pitches it for travel too.
highlights: 7.3 oz tank, up to 20 min steam

name: Levoit Core 300-P True HEPA Air Purifier, White
shortDescription: A compact cylindrical air purifier with a 3-stage filter, AHAM-verified CADR ratings, a 24 dB sleep mode and a display that can be turned off.
description: The Levoit Core 300-P is a compact air purifier with a 3-in-1 filter. It's AHAM Verifide with CADR ratings of 143 CFM for smoke, 153 CFM for dust and 167 CFM for pollen, which the listing says refreshes the air in a 222 sq ft room 4.8 times an hour. Filtration efficiency is listed at 99.97% for 0.1-0.3 µm particles. Sleep mode runs at 24 dB, the display lights can be switched off, and it has a 2/4/6/8-hour timer and a filter-change indicator. It measures 8.7 x 8.7 x 14.2 in.
whyWeLikeIt: It's small, quiet and simple, which is why it's one of the most-reviewed purifiers on Amazon. Easy to put in a bedroom without it looking like an appliance.
highlights: AHAM Verifide CADR: 143 smoke / 153 dust / 167 pollen
Display can be turned off; 2-8 hr timer

name: Furbo 360° Dog Camera with Treat Toss
shortDescription: A rotating 1080p pet camera that tosses treats on command from your phone, with 2-way audio, barking alerts and color night vision, no subscription required.
description: The Furbo 360° is a home camera designed for dogs. It streams 1080p video with a motorized 360° rotating view and 4x zoom, has 2-way audio and color night vision, sends barking alerts, and tosses treats remotely through the free Furbo app, with adjustable treat size, per the listing. This model works without a subscription; premium AI smart alerts from the Furbo Nanny plan are not included.
whyWeLikeIt: Tossing a treat to your dog from the office is the feature everyone wants to show off, and the rotating camera actually covers the whole room.
highlights: No subscription required for these features

name: YVE LIFE Automatic Cat Laser Toy, White
shortDescription: A motion-activated laser toy that moves the dot in random patterns for 15-minute play sessions, with 3 speed modes and a rechargeable battery.
description: This YVE LIFE toy projects a laser dot that moves in random patterns driven by two motors. A sensor switches it on when it detects your pet moving, and each session runs 15 minutes before turning off; the sensor can re-trigger every 2 hours, per the listing. It has fast, slow and mixed speed modes, and the laser head angle adjusts up to 50° vertically. A 1200 mAh USB-rechargeable battery charges in about 2.5 hours and lasts up to 2 days, or it can run plugged in. The listing recommends placing it 8-35 inches high.
whyWeLikeIt: It plays with the cat when you can't, and the random pattern keeps it from becoming predictable. A cheap fix for an indoor cat with too much energy.

name: Veken Stainless Steel Cat Water Fountain, 108 oz
shortDescription: A 3.2-liter 304 stainless-steel pet water fountain with a 25 dB suspended pump, water-level window with optional blue light, and multi-stage filter.
description: This Veken fountain keeps water circulating for cats and small dogs. It's made of 304 stainless steel, holds 108 oz (3.2 L), and all water-contact parts are top-rack dishwasher safe and BPA-free, per the listing. A suspended pump runs at about 25 dB. A large viewing window shows the water level, with an optional blue LED glow. It assembles in four snap-together steps and includes 3 filters, 3 sponges and a silicone mat.
whyWeLikeIt: Moving water gets more cats drinking, and stainless steel is easier to keep clean than the plastic fountains most people start with.
highlights: Water-level window with optional blue light

name: SOICTA Portable Dog Water Bottle, 19 oz, Blue
shortDescription: A leak-proof 19 oz dog water bottle with a fold-out drinking trough and one-touch release, for walks and trips.
description: This SOICTA bottle holds 19 oz of water with a trough that folds out for a dog to drink from. A one-touch button releases water into the trough, and a valve lets most of the unused water flow back into the bottle, per the listing. Silicone sealing rings and a lock key are designed to prevent leaks. It has a nylon lanyard and is made from food-grade materials. The listing says not to put it in a dishwasher. This is the blue 19 oz version.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns 'my dog needs water' on a walk into a one-handed job, with no bowl to carry and almost no water wasted.
highlights: One-touch release; unused water flows back

name: Ticktime T6 Pomodoro Flip Timer Cube, Silver
shortDescription: A palm-size timer cube you flip to start a preset countdown (3 to 60 minutes), with a 25/5 Pomodoro cycle, custom timers, stopwatch and silent, vibration or sound alerts.
description: The Ticktime T6 is a small rechargeable timer cube with a built-in gyroscope: flip it onto a side to instantly start a preset interval of 3, 5, 10, 15, 25, 45 or 60 minutes, per the listing. It has a preset Pomodoro cycle (25 minutes of focus, 5 minutes of rest), custom countdowns from 1 second to 99 minutes 59 seconds, a stopwatch mode, and pause and resume. Alerts can be sound, vibration or silent flash. It has an LED display and charges over USB-C. It measures about 1.9 x 1.7 x 1.8 in. This is the silver version.
whyWeLikeIt: Flipping a physical cube is a much stronger 'start working' signal than opening a timer app on the phone that distracts you. It's as useful in the kitchen as on the desk.

name: Scratch the World Travel Map Poster, 23 x 33 in
shortDescription: A large scratch-off world map with US states: scratch away the gold foil on places you've visited to reveal a colorful political map underneath.
description: This Maps International scratch-off map measures 23 x 33 in. (A1 size, easy to frame). The gold top coating shows country and US state outlines; scratching a destination off reveals the colorful political map beneath, per the listing. The map was updated in 2026 and ships rolled in a tube so it arrives without creases.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns trips into something you can see on the wall, and scratching off a new country after a vacation is genuinely satisfying. A go-to gift for anyone who travels.
highlights: Gold foil scratches off to color map

name: Yoto Mini (2024 Edition) Kids Audio Player
shortDescription: A screen-free audio player for kids ages 3-12 that plays stories and music from physical cards, with a pixel display, up to 14 hours of battery, and no camera, mic or ads.
description: Yoto Mini lets children play audio by inserting physical cards: insert a card to play, remove it to stop, and use the dials for volume and tracks, per the listing. The card library covers 1000+ audiobooks, music, educational content and more, plus Make Your Own cards. It has a pixel display and can also act as a sleep-sounds player, a bedtime storyteller, an OK-to-wake clock or a portable speaker, and it works with headphones. Battery life is up to 14 hours. It has no camera, no microphone and no ads, and parents can control it through a free app.
whyWeLikeIt: It gives kids independence over what they listen to without handing them a screen, which is why parents swear by it for car rides and bedtime.
highlights: No camera, no mic, no ads

name: Snap Circuits Jr. SC-100 Electronics Kit
shortDescription: A beginner electronics kit with 30+ color-coded snap-together parts and a full-color manual for 100+ projects, no soldering or tools needed, for ages 8+.
description: Snap Circuits Jr. teaches the basics of electronics by snapping numbered, color-coded components onto a plastic grid to build working circuits, per the listing. The SC-100 kit includes 30+ snap modules, the snap board and a full-color manual with over 100 projects, such as a flying saucer that launches. No soldering or tools are required. Batteries are required and are not described as included. It's for ages 8 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the classic first electronics kit because it works: kids build real circuits in minutes and see lights, sounds and motors respond.

name: Celestron Travel Scope 70 Portable Telescope with Backpack
shortDescription: A 70mm refractor telescope with full-height tripod, two eyepieces and a padded backpack, set up without tools for Moon, planets and daytime viewing.
description: The Celestron Travel Scope 70 is a 70 mm refractor with fully coated glass lenses, for views of the Moon, planets and daytime scenery, per the listing. It sets up without tools on a full-height tripod and packs into the included padded backpack. It comes with 20 mm and 10 mm eyepieces, a finderscope and a star diagonal, plus a free download of Starry Night software. It uses an altazimuth mount.
whyWeLikeIt: A real telescope that fits in a backpack, so it goes camping or to the roof instead of living in a closet. A great first scope for families.
highlights: Finderscope, star diagonal, Starry Night software

name: AstroAI L7 Cordless Tire Inflator, 150 PSI
shortDescription: A cordless, sub-1-lb air compressor with a digital gauge, preset modes for car, bike, motorcycle and balls, auto shut-off and a built-in flashlight.
description: The AstroAI L7 is a rechargeable portable inflator weighing under 1 lb. You preset the target pressure (3-150 PSI) or pick a mode for car, motorcycle, bicycle or ball, and it stops automatically when it reaches it, per the listing. The display reads PSI, Bar, kPa or kg/cm². Its 4000 mAh battery can top up to 8 car tires (195/65R15) from 30 to 36 PSI on a charge, according to the listing. It charges via USB-C and has a flashlight with regular, SOS and strobe modes. This is the orange version.
whyWeLikeIt: It lives in the glovebox and fixes a low tire light in minutes without hunting for a gas-station air pump, and it does bikes and balls too.
highlights: Presets: car, motorcycle, bike, ball, custom

name: Bosch GLM100-23 Blaze 100 ft Laser Measure
shortDescription: A pocket laser distance measure accurate to 1/16 inch up to 100 feet, with two-button operation, a backlit display and a rounding button.
description: The Bosch GLM100-23 Blaze measures distances up to 100 ft to within 1/16 inch, displaying results in meters, feet or inches with fractions or decimals, per the listing. It uses two buttons (one to measure, one to round results from 1/2 in. to 1/32 in.) and has a backlit display with large icons. It's pocket-sized, weighs about 86 g and uses a Class II laser. Two AA batteries are included.
whyWeLikeIt: Measuring a room alone with a tape measure is a two-person job; this makes it a one-click job. Handy for moving, furniture shopping and DIY.
highlights: Up to 100 ft, accurate to 1/16 in.

name: iFixit Mako 64-Bit Precision Driver Kit
shortDescription: A 64-bit precision screwdriver set for electronics repair, with an aluminum magnetic driver, flexible extension, and a magnetic case that doubles as a sorting tray.
description: The iFixit Mako kit includes 64 precision bits, including Torx and security types like tri-wing and Pentalobe, for repairing phones, game consoles and laptops, per the listing. It comes with a 4 mm anodized aluminum driver handle with a magnetic socket, knurled grip and swivel top, plus a flexible extension. Everything is stored in a foam insert inside a magnetic case whose lid works as a parts-sorting tray.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the kit that means you actually can open that console, phone or laptop, instead of giving up at the first odd screw. A useful gift for any tinkerer.
highlights: Magnetic case; lid is a sorting tray

name: Fanttik E1 Max Electric Precision Screwdriver, Grey
shortDescription: A pen-size electric precision screwdriver with 50 magnetic S2 bits, adjustable torque, LED light and USB-C charging, in a pop-up magnetic case.
description: The Fanttik E1 Max is a rechargeable precision screwdriver for small electronics. According to the listing, its 200 RPM motor has high (0.2 N·m) and low (0.05 N·m) torque settings, plus up to 3 N·m when turned manually. It comes with 50 S2 steel bits in 12 types, stored in a magnetic case with a pop-up mechanism, and both chuck and bits are magnetic. The 350 mAh battery charges via USB-C and is rated for about 450 small screws per charge. It has an LED light and won 2023 iF and 2024 Red Dot design awards, per the listing. This is the grey color.
whyWeLikeIt: Tiny screws are where manual drivers get tedious; this does the spinning while keeping the torque gentle enough for electronics. The case alone is fidget-worthy.

name: Back to the Roots Organic Oyster Mushroom Grow Kit
shortDescription: An organic countertop kit: open the box, mist daily, and harvest oyster mushrooms in about 10 days.
description: This Back to the Roots kit grows organic oyster mushrooms straight out of its box. Place it near a window with indirect light, mist with the included sprayer daily, and the listing says you'll be harvesting in about 10 days. Each crop yields three to four servings, and each box can grow up to two crops. It's organic, non-GMO and made in the USA, and it comes in giftable packaging.
whyWeLikeIt: Watching mushrooms visibly grow day by day is weirdly exciting, and you get to eat the result. It's one of the best under-$25 gifts for a foodie.
highlights: 3-4 servings per crop, up to 2 crops

name: Shop Succulents Assorted Tillandsia Air Plants, 12-Pack
shortDescription: Twelve hand-selected live Tillandsia air plants in assorted shapes and sizes that grow without soil, for terrariums, driftwood or hanging displays.
description: This Shop Succulents pack contains 12 assorted live Tillandsia air plants, hand-selected for a variety of sizes, shapes and colors, per the listing. Air plants don't need soil: keep them in bright, indirect light and water by misting or soaking weekly, with good air circulation. They suit terrariums, hanging displays, driftwood mounts and craft projects.
whyWeLikeIt: Plants that don't need a pot open up displays you can't do with anything else, like hanging glass globes or a piece of driftwood. Twelve of them is enough to decorate a whole shelf.

name: Glocusent Rechargeable Neck Reading Light, Gray
shortDescription: A hands-free LED light that rests around your neck with two bendable arms, 3 color temperatures, adjustable brightness and up to 80 hours per charge.
description: The Glocusent neck light wraps around the neck with two flexible arms that each hold an LED head with its own switch. It has three color temperatures (3000K yellow, 4000K warm white and 6000K cool white) and three brightness levels per head, per the listing. A narrow 90° beam lights the page without lighting up the room. It charges via USB-C and runs up to 80 hours on low with a single head, or 8-10 hours on high. This is the gray standard/medium version.
whyWeLikeIt: It lets you read in bed without keeping a partner awake, and it's just as handy for knitting, crafts or working under a sink. One of Amazon's most-reviewed book lights for a reason.
highlights: Wraps around the neck, 2 bendable arms

name: Buddew Electric Heated Lunch Box, 1.5L, Green
shortDescription: A portable food warmer lunch box that heats a home-cooked meal in 15-30 minutes from a wall outlet, car or truck, with a 1.5 L stainless-steel container.
description: The Buddew heated lunch box warms food in about 15-30 minutes using a 100 W PTC heating element, per the listing. It works with 110 V wall power, 12 V car outlets and 24 V truck outlets. The 1.5 L food container is 304 stainless steel, BPA-free and dishwasher safe. This is the green version.
whyWeLikeIt: A hot homemade lunch at a desk, on a job site or on a road trip, without a microwave queue. It's the kind of gadget people didn't know existed.
highlights: Works on 110 V, 12 V car, 24 V truck

name: SodaStream TERRA Sparkling Water Maker Starter Kit, Black
shortDescription: A countertop machine that carbonates tap water at the press of a button, with a Quick Connect CO2 cylinder that makes up to 60 liters.
description: The SodaStream TERRA carbonates plain tap water in seconds: one press for light fizz, a few more for stronger bubbles, per the listing. The Quick Connect CO2 cylinder clicks in with one push and makes up to 60 liters (16 gallons) of sparkling water; cylinders can be exchanged at participating retailers. The starter kit includes the machine, one 60 L CO2 cylinder, one dishwasher-safe BPA-free bottle and a bubly flavor drop. It's slim enough to fit under most upper cabinets.
whyWeLikeIt: It replaces a whole shelf of bottled sparkling water, and fizzing your own is surprisingly fun. A good gift for anyone who drinks seltzer daily.
highlights: Quick Connect CO2: up to 60 L per cylinder

name: TINANA Crystal Clear Ice Ball Maker, 4 Spheres
shortDescription: An insulated mold that freezes four large, crystal-clear ice spheres (about 2.4 in.) at once, for whiskey and cocktails.
description: The TINANA ice ball maker produces four large, clear ice spheres per batch, each about 2.36 in. across, per the listing. Fill it with water and freeze it for 26-30 hours, then remove the tray to get nearly transparent spheres. Large spheres melt more slowly than regular cubes and fit standard rocks glasses. The mold is made of silicone for easy release.
whyWeLikeIt: Clear ice is the bar trick that makes a home drink look professional, and the patience it takes makes every sphere feel earned.

name: ComboJoy Whiskey & Cocktail Smoker Kit with Torch
shortDescription: A gift-boxed cocktail smoker set: an oak smoker top, torch, six wood chip flavors, two glasses and two ice ball molds.
description: This ComboJoy kit infuses drinks and food with wood smoke. Place the oak smoker top over a glass, light the included wood chips with the torch, and let the smoke settle into the drink, per the listing. The set includes the smoker top with a stainless-steel mesh filter, a torch (butane not included), six varieties of natural wood chips, two glasses and two ice ball molds, in a gift box. It can also be used on cheese, meats and other foods.
whyWeLikeIt: A smoked old fashioned is pure theater at a home bar, and this box contains everything but the whiskey. One of the easiest 'wow' gifts for a drinks lover.

name: Oster Cordless Electric Wine Opener, Silver
shortDescription: A push-button cordless corkscrew that removes a cork in seconds, opens up to 30 bottles per charge, and includes a foil cutter and charging base.
description: The Oster electric wine opener removes a cork with the push of a button, per the listing. It opens up to 30 bottles on a single charge, which takes 6-8 hours in the included recharging base. A foil cutter is included, and the handle has a soft grip. This is the silver version.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes opening a bottle effortless, which is exactly why it's a go-to host gift. Tens of thousands of reviews back it up.

name: BONAOK Bluetooth Karaoke Microphone Q37, Rose Gold
shortDescription: A handheld karaoke microphone with a built-in Bluetooth speaker, echo effect and separate volume controls, usable with singing apps on any phone.
description: The BONAOK Q37 combines a microphone and speaker in one handheld unit. It connects to a phone by Bluetooth (about 10 m range) or cable to sing along with karaoke apps, and can also act as a wireless speaker, MP3 player or recorder, per the listing. Buttons adjust microphone, echo and music volume separately, and it reads micro SD cards up to 32 GB (not included). It comes with an audio cable and a charging cable. This is the rose gold version.
whyWeLikeIt: Instant party: pair a phone, open a karaoke app, and the mic is the whole sound system. Kids and adults both grab it.
highlights: micro SD support up to 32 GB

name: Back to the Roots Water Garden Aquaponic Fish Tank, 3 Gal
shortDescription: A 3-gallon self-cleaning fish tank with a garden bed on top: fish waste fertilizes the plants, and the plants clean the water.
description: The Back to the Roots Water Garden is a small aquaponic ecosystem: a 3-gallon fish tank with a growing tray on top. Fish waste fertilizes the plants, and the plants help clean the water, per the listing. The kit includes radish and wheatgrass seeds, growing medium, water conditioner, dechlorinator, fish food and a fish coupon, plus a free STEM curriculum. The listing says microgreens can be harvested in about 10 days. It's made in the USA.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a living science lesson on a countertop: a betta below, microgreens above, each looking after the other. Kids and adults both get hooked.
highlights: Seeds, medium, conditioner, fish food + fish coupon

name: Dan&Darci Light-Up Ant Farm Gel Habitat Kit
shortDescription: An LED-lit gel ant habitat where live ants dig visible tunnels, with nutrient gel and a coupon for ants.
description: This Dan&Darci kit is a clear, LED-lit habitat filled with nutrient-rich gel that ants tunnel through, so the whole colony's digging is visible from the side, per the listing. The kit includes the habitat, the gel and a coupon for live ants. It's sold as a STEM science toy for kids.
whyWeLikeIt: Watching tunnels appear day by day is endlessly fascinating for kids, and the light-up base makes it just as good at night. A classic science gift, modernized.
highlights: Clear gel habitat ants tunnel through

name: National Geographic Mega Crystal Growing Kit
shortDescription: A kids' science kit for growing six colored crystals in 3-4 days, including a glow-in-the-dark crystal, a light-up display and four real gemstone specimens.
description: This National Geographic kit from Blue Marble grows six crystals in blue, red, purple, green, yellow and glow-in-the-dark, with crystals forming in about 3-4 days, per the listing. Two silicone growing chambers make the process easier. A USB-powered light-up stand (cable included) displays five finished crystals. It also includes four real specimens (rose quartz, fluorite, blue calcite and a quartz geode) and a full-color learning guide. It's an Amazon exclusive for ages 8 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: Kids get a science experiment with a result they can keep and show off, and the light-up display turns it into a night light for their room.

name: La Crosse Technology Color Weather Station with Atomic Time
shortDescription: A full-color LCD weather station with a wireless outdoor sensor, indoor/outdoor temperature and humidity, forecast icons, and self-setting atomic time.
description: This La Crosse Technology station shows indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity with min/max records and customizable alerts, using a weather-resistant outdoor sensor with up to 330 ft range, per the listing. Color forecast icons with trend indicators predict conditions. Time and calendar set themselves via the atomic signal, with automatic daylight saving time. It has an alarm with snooze and an adjustable backlight; a 5V adapter powers the full display, with 3 AAA batteries as optional backup.
whyWeLikeIt: One glance on the kitchen counter tells you what to wear before leaving the house, no phone needed. The color display makes it a nice-looking object too.

name: Temtop C1 CO2 Monitor with Temperature & Humidity
shortDescription: A compact indoor air-quality monitor that reads CO2 (400-5000 ppm) with an NDIR sensor, plus temperature and humidity, with alerts you can silence.
description: The Temtop C1 measures indoor carbon dioxide from 400 to 5000 ppm using an NDIR sensor, with a listed accuracy of ±40 ppm +5% of reading in the 400-2500 ppm range and a 5-second refresh, per the listing. It also shows temperature (14°F to 140°F) and humidity (0-99% RH). The buzzer and screen light can be turned off. It's USB powered and can run on its battery; the listing recommends keeping it plugged in for real-time monitoring. A bracket is included.
whyWeLikeIt: Stuffy-room tiredness usually means high CO2, and this makes it visible so you know when to open a window. Useful on a desk, in a bedroom or a meeting room.

name: OLIGHT i3T 2 EOS Pocket EDC Flashlight, Black
shortDescription: A slim aluminum AAA flashlight putting out up to 200 lumens with a 62 m beam, IPX8 waterproof, with a two-way pocket clip.
description: The OLIGHT i3T 2 EOS is a small aluminum everyday-carry flashlight that runs on a single AAA battery (included). It delivers up to 200 lumens and a 62-meter beam, or up to 300 lumens with a rechargeable AAA, per the listing. It can start in low or high mode, is IPX8 waterproof to 3 meters, and has a two-way clip that attaches horizontally or vertically to pockets, belts or straps. This is the black standard edition.
whyWeLikeIt: It's small enough to clip anywhere and forget about until you need it, and it runs on batteries you can buy anywhere in the world.

name: The Ridge Wallet with Money Clip, Forest Green
shortDescription: A slim aluminum card-holder wallet that holds 1-12 cards with RFID blocking and an integrated money clip, weighing 1.5 oz.
description: The Ridge is a minimalist front-pocket wallet made of two 6061-T6 aluminum plates held by elastic, which expands to hold 1-12 cards without stretching out, per the listing. The aluminum body blocks RFID readers, a notch on the outside lets you push cards out, and an integrated money clip holds bills on the outside. It weighs 1.5 oz and measures 86 x 54 x 6 mm. Ridge backs it with a lifetime guarantee. This is the forest green version.
whyWeLikeIt: It forces you down to the cards you actually use and turns a bulky wallet into something that disappears in a front pocket. A classic gift upgrade.

name: KeySmart Original Compact Key Holder, Black
shortDescription: A slim aluminum key organizer that stacks up to 8 flat keys like a pocket knife (expandable to 14), with a loop for a car fob.
description: KeySmart holds your existing keys between two aircraft-grade aluminum frames with stainless-steel hardware, so they fold out like a pocket knife instead of jingling on a ring, per the listing. It holds up to 8 standard flat keys and expands to 14 with the included expansion kit, and a loop attaches a larger car fob. It's assembled without tools and weighs about 18 g. Accessories like bottle openers and clips are sold separately. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: No more jingling or keys stabbing through a pocket, and the right key is always easy to find. A small upgrade people notice every day.

name: WHOOSH! Screen Shine Pro Screen Cleaner Kit, 16.9 oz
shortDescription: A refillable 16.9 oz screen-cleaning spray with a large microfiber cloth, for TVs, laptops, tablets and phones including OLED and anti-glare screens.
description: WHOOSH! Screen Shine Pro is a spray screen cleaner for TVs, laptops, tablets, phones and glasses. The listing describes it as streak-free and safe on anti-glare, coated, OLED and LCD displays. The formula is alcohol-free, ammonia-free and odorless. The kit includes a refillable 16.9 fl oz (500 ml) bottle and a large 14 x 14 in. machine-washable microfiber cloth.
whyWeLikeIt: Smudged screens are everywhere in a home, and this is the one bottle that handles all of them without streaks. Cheap, useful, and it lasts a long time.

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Noise Canceling Headphones, Black
shortDescription: Sony's flagship wireless over-ear headphones with 8-microphone noise canceling, up to 30 hours of battery, multipoint pairing and a carry case.
description: The WH-1000XM5 uses two processors controlling eight microphones for noise canceling, with an Auto NC Optimizer that adjusts to your environment and fit, per the listing. Four beamforming microphones handle calls. Battery life is up to 30 hours, and a 3-minute charge gives 3 hours of playback. It supports multipoint connection to switch between devices, and has soft-fit leather cushions. The box includes a carry case, a headphone cable and a USB-C cable. This is the black color.
whyWeLikeIt: For flights, commutes and open offices, top-tier noise canceling is the single best comfort upgrade, and these are the benchmark.
highlights: 8-mic noise canceling with Auto NC Optimizer

name: LAPGEAR Designer Lap Desk, Arrow Stripes
shortDescription: A cushioned lap desk with a 17.3 x 13.3 in. surface for laptops up to 15.6 in., a phone slot, a front ledge and a carry handle.
description: The LAPGEAR Designer Lap Desk has a flat 17.3 x 13.3 in. surface that fits laptops up to 15.6 in., tablets or notebooks, with a microbead cushion underneath that conforms to your lap, per the listing. A built-in slot holds a phone upright, a front ledge stops devices sliding off, and a built-in handle makes it easy to carry. It weighs about 2 lb. This is the Arrow Stripes design.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes working from the couch or bed comfortable instead of balancing a hot laptop on your knees. Cheap, simple and used every day.
highlights: 17.3 x 13.3 in. surface; fits 15.6 in. laptops

name: FLYHIT Large Towel Warmer Bucket, White
shortDescription: A heated bucket that warms two oversized bath towels (or robes and blankets) in about 25 minutes, with a timer, wood lid and auto shut-off.
description: The FLYHIT towel warmer is a freestanding bucket with a wooden lid that holds two oversized 40 x 70 in. bath towels, or about five medium towels, plus robes, blankets or pajamas, per the listing. Press WORK and its 450 W heater warms them in about 25 minutes, and a timer sets how long to keep them warm. It's ETL certified with a triple-layer temperature control and automatic shut-off. It measures about 11.5 x 11.5 x 17.6 in. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: A warm towel out of the shower feels like a hotel spa every day, and it's a gift nobody buys for themselves.

name: Chunace Motion-Sensor Toilet Bowl Night Light, 2-Pack
shortDescription: A motion-activated LED that hooks onto the toilet rim and glows inside the bowl in 16 colors, turning off after 2 minutes of inactivity.
description: This Chunace light hangs on the toilet bowl rim with a flexible arm and switches on when its 170° motion sensor detects movement in the dark, then turns off after 2 minutes without motion, per the listing. It offers 16 LED colors or automatic color cycling, and 5 brightness levels. Each unit runs on 3 AA batteries (not included). This is a 2-pack.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the funny gadget that turns out to be genuinely useful: no blinding light switch at 3 a.m., and kids love it for potty training.

name: Drop Stop Car Seat Gap Filler, 2-Pack
shortDescription: The Shark Tank neoprene gap filler that seals the space between car seat and center console so phones and keys stop falling in, 2-pack.
description: Drop Stop fills the gap between a car seat and the center console. It attaches to the seat belt catch through a built-in slot, so it moves with the seat without readjusting, per the listing. The neoprene casing expands or contracts to fit the gap, and one size fits most vehicles. This pack includes two Drop Stops (driver and passenger), plus a slide-free dash pad and an LED credit-card light.
whyWeLikeIt: Everyone has lost a phone or fries down that gap while driving; this ends it permanently for the price of a lunch.
highlights: Attaches via seat belt catch; moves with seat
Bonus dash pad + LED card light

name: Helinox Chair Zero Ultralight Camping Chair, Black
shortDescription: A 1.1 lb backpacking chair that packs smaller than a water bottle and holds up to 265 lb, with a DAC aluminum frame.
description: The Helinox Chair Zero weighs 1.1 lb and packs down to 4 x 4 x 13.5 in., smaller than a bottle of water, per the listing. Its DAC aluminum alloy frame holds up to 265 lb, and a single internal bungee cord assembles the poles quickly. The seat and carry sack are ripstop polyester that resists weather and UV and is machine washable. Assembled it measures 20 x 18 x 25 in. with a 6.5 in. seat height. Helinox gives a five-year warranty. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: A real chair that weighs about as much as a water bottle means you actually bring it on hikes, to festivals and to the beach.
highlights: 1.1 lb; packs to 4 x 4 x 13.5 in.

name: WEKAPO Inflatable Air Lounger Couch, Blue
shortDescription: An inflatable couch you fill by swinging it through the air, no pump needed, with a pillow headrest, stake and carry bag.
description: The WEKAPO air lounger inflates without a pump: you sweep the open sleeve through the air to trap air, then close it, per the listing. It has a pillow-shaped headrest and is designed to stay inflated for 5-6 hours. It measures 82 x 27 x 35 in. inflated and weighs about 2 lb. A carry bag, a ground stake with security loop, and a bottle opener are included. This is the blue version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the thing everyone at the beach or festival asks about, and it packs into a bag the size of a water bottle.

name: Victorinox Classic SD Swiss Army Knife, Red
shortDescription: The classic 7-function mini Swiss Army Knife: small blade, scissors, nail file with screwdriver, toothpick, tweezers and key ring, at 21 g.
description: The Victorinox Classic SD is the small keychain Swiss Army Knife. Its seven functions include a small blade, scissors, a nail file with screwdriver tip, a toothpick, tweezers and a key ring, per the listing. It measures 58 mm long, 18 mm wide and 9 mm high and weighs about 21 g, with ABS/Cellidor scales. It's Swiss made. This is the classic red.
whyWeLikeIt: The tiny scissors alone justify carrying it; it's the pocket tool people end up using several times a week. A timeless small gift.

name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker, 6 Qt
shortDescription: The 6-quart multicooker that pressure cooks, slow cooks, sautés, steams, makes rice and yogurt, and keeps food warm, with 13 one-touch programs.
description: The Instant Pot Duo combines seven functions: pressure cooker, slow cooker, sauté, steamer, rice cooker, yogurt maker and warmer, per the listing. It has 13 one-touch smart programs and an Easy-Release steam switch. The 6-quart inner pot is 18/8 stainless steel with a tri-ply bottom for searing, and both the inner pot and lid are dishwasher safe. It's 1000 W and serves up to about 6 people.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the appliance that makes weeknight stews, rice and beans genuinely fast, and it replaces three other gadgets on the counter.

name: Retevis RT628 Kids Walkie Talkies, 2-Pack, Red
shortDescription: A pair of license-free kids' walkie talkies with 22 channels, hands-free VOX talking, a keypad lock and belt clips.
description: The Retevis RT628 is a two-pack of compact walkie talkies designed for kids ages 6-12. They have 22 channels, a VOX mode for hands-free talking without pressing buttons, 8 volume levels and a keypad lock to prevent accidental channel changes, per the listing. They're license-free, have belt clips, and each measures 6.2 x 2.1 x 1.1 in. Each unit needs 3 AA batteries (not included). This is the red pair.
whyWeLikeIt: Walkie talkies turn a backyard, a campsite or a big store into an adventure for kids, and give parents a way to stay in touch without handing over a phone.

name: KUNPHY 46kHz Ultrasonic Jewelry Cleaner, White
shortDescription: A compact ultrasonic cleaner that uses 46,000 Hz sound waves in a 350 ml tank to clean jewelry, glasses and retainers with one touch.
description: The KUNPHY ultrasonic cleaner uses 46,000 Hz sound waves to shake dirt loose from all surfaces of items in its 350 ml tank, per the listing. It's for rings, necklaces, eyeglasses, retainers and similar small items. One touch starts a 3-minute cycle, and it runs at under 45 dB. The listing notes that black tarnish on silver is oxidation and needs other methods. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: Glasses and rings come out looking new with zero scrubbing, which is oddly satisfying to watch. A thoughtful gift for anyone who wears jewelry every day.

name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with 1080p Camera, 5L
shortDescription: A 5-liter automatic pet feeder with a built-in 1080p night-vision camera, app scheduling, two-way audio and low-food and blockage alerts.
description: The PETLIBRO feeder dispenses dry food on schedules set in the PETLIBRO app, or on demand while you're away, per the listing. A 1080p camera with a 145° lens and infrared night vision lets you watch mealtimes, with recording to a micro SD card up to 256 GB (not included) or cloud video. Two-way audio and recorded 10-second meal calls let you talk to your pet. It sends alerts for low food, blockages, motion and sound. It works on 5G or 2.4G Wi-Fi. This is the white 5 L camera model.
whyWeLikeIt: Feeding on schedule plus a camera to see them actually eat takes the worry out of long workdays and weekends away.
highlights: 5 L automatic feeder with app schedules

name: Zakkart Cat Window Perch with Bolsters, Large
shortDescription: A hook-on windowsill cat bed with a hardwood and metal frame, washable bolster cushion and 40 lb capacity, no suction cups or drilling.
description: The Zakkart perch hooks onto a windowsill (the window needs a slot at least 0.5 in. deep) and adjusts to sills up to 9 in. deep, with no suction cups or drilling, per the listing. The frame is hardwood and metal, it holds up to 40 lb, and the large bed is 24 x 15 in. with bolsters. The cushion is sewn onto the frame with a sleeve and is removable for machine washing. This is the natural wood/gray large size.
whyWeLikeIt: Cats love a window seat, and this gives them one without taking floor space or trusting suction cups. It moves easily between windows.
highlights: Hooks onto sill; no suction cups or drilling
Fits sills up to 9 in. deep

name: Outward Hound Nina Ottosson Dog Brick Treat Puzzle
shortDescription: A level-2 dog puzzle where dogs lift bones, flip lids and slide blocks to find hidden treats; also works as a slow feeder.
description: The Dog Brick is an intermediate (level 2) Nina Ottosson treat puzzle. Dogs pick up bones, flip open lids and move sliders to uncover hidden treats, with three difficulty setups and tips included for adjusting the challenge, per the listing. It holds 3/4 cup of kibble or treats, so it can also serve as a slow feeder. It measures 12.75 x 9.25 x 2 in. This is the blue version.
whyWeLikeIt: It gives a bored dog a job, and the three ways to hide treats keep it interesting longer than a regular chew toy.
highlights: Lift bones, flip lids, move sliders
Holds 3/4 cup; doubles as slow feeder

name: oneisall 7-in-1 Dog Grooming Vacuum Kit, Blue
shortDescription: A pet grooming kit that vacuums loose hair as you brush and clip, with 7 tools including clipper, paw trimmer and nail grinder, and a 1.5 L dust cup.
description: This oneisall kit connects grooming tools to a vacuum so loose hair is sucked straight into a 1.5 L detachable dust cup while you groom, per the listing. It includes a grooming brush, a deshedding tool, an electric clipper, a paw trimmer and a nail grinder among its 7 tools. It has 3 suction levels and runs at about 59 dB. The hose is 5.2 ft and the power cord 8.7 ft, and accessories store in an included bag. It's rated for 110-130 V. This is the blue model LM2.
whyWeLikeIt: Grooming a shedding dog at home usually means fur everywhere; this pulls the hair away as you go, so cleanup is emptying a cup.
highlights: 7 tools incl. clipper, paw trimmer, nail grinder

name: Repel Windproof Travel Umbrella, Black
shortDescription: A compact auto open/close travel umbrella with a fiberglass frame and steel shaft, built to withstand winds up to 100 mph per the listing.
description: The Repel Windproof Travel Umbrella is a compact folding umbrella with automatic opening and closing. The listing says it withstands winds up to 100 mph. It has a fiberglass frame, a steel shaft and a latex-free rubber handle, and comes with a cover. It's sized to fit in a backpack or car. This is the black single pack.
whyWeLikeIt: The cheap umbrella that flips inside out in the first gust is a universal experience; this is the one people buy after that happens.
highlights: Rated for winds up to 100 mph (listed)

name: Rachio 3 Smart Sprinkler Controller, 8-Zone
shortDescription: A Wi-Fi sprinkler controller that replaces the old dial timer, with app control and automatic skips for rain, wind and freeze.
description: Rachio 3 replaces a standard in-ground sprinkler timer with a Wi-Fi controller managed from the Rachio app, per the listing. Its Weather Intelligence automatically skips watering for rain, wind, freezing temperatures and more, and adaptive schedules adjust through the seasons. You can run zones, view schedules and track estimated water usage from anywhere. It's an 8-zone controller, described as installing in 30 minutes or less and compatible with 99% of existing sprinkler systems. It carries a 2-year limited warranty and is for use in the US and Canada.
whyWeLikeIt: It stops the sprinklers running in the rain, which is the most visible (and wasteful) failure of a regular timer, and makes the yard controllable from a phone.

name: Delamu 20-in-1 Sushi Making Kit with Bazooka Roller
shortDescription: A complete home sushi kit with bamboo mats, a bazooka roller, temaki rollers, rice mold, sushi knife, chopsticks and a step-by-step guide.
description: The Delamu kit covers rolls, hand rolls (temaki), nigiri and gunkan. It includes 2 bamboo sushi mats, 1 bazooka roller, 2 temaki rollers, 1 rice mold, 1 sushi knife, 5 pairs of chopsticks, 2 chopstick holders, a rice paddle, a rice spreader and 2 sauce dishes, per the listing, plus a guide book with rice preparation, rolling techniques and six recipes. Parts are food-safe and BPA-free.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns sushi into a fun group activity at home, and the bazooka roller makes perfect rolls easy even for beginners. A great gift under $25.

name: LEGO Technic Ferrari FXX K (42212)
shortDescription: An 897-piece LEGO Technic build of the Ferrari FXX K with butterfly doors, a V12 engine with moving pistons and a working differential, for ages 10+.
description: LEGO Technic set 42212 builds the Ferrari FXX K in its racing red. It has working butterfly doors, an opening hood and an engine cover that reveals a detailed V12 with moving pistons, plus a working differential, per the listing. The completed 897-piece model measures over 3 in. high, 11 in. long and 4.5 in. wide. The LEGO Builder app offers 3D zoom and rotate instructions. It's for ages 10 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: Mechanical LEGO is a real engineering lesson disguised as a toy, and the finished Ferrari looks great on a shelf afterwards.

name: Zojirushi Micom 3-Cup Rice Cooker & Warmer
shortDescription: A compact microcomputer rice cooker for small households, cooking from 1/2 cup, with settings for long-grain white, brown/GABA and steel-cut oatmeal.
description: The Zojirushi Micom NS-LGC05 is a 3-cup (uncooked) rice cooker and warmer that can cook as little as 1/2 cup of rice or oats, per the listing. It has dedicated settings for long-grain white rice, brown rice, GABA brown rice (which holds brown rice at about 104°F for 2 hours) and steel-cut oatmeal, among others. A fold-down handle and retractable power cord make it easy to move and store. It includes a spatula and measuring cup. This is the stainless black finish.
whyWeLikeIt: Perfect rice every time, sized for one or two people, from the brand rice lovers trust. It's the appliance that quietly gets used every single day.

name: XPPen Deco 01 V3 Drawing Tablet, 10 x 6 in.
shortDescription: A thin 10 x 6.25 in. pen tablet with a battery-free 16K-pressure stylus, tilt support and 8 shortcut keys, for Windows, Mac, ChromeOS, Linux and Android.
description: The XPPen Deco 01 V3 is a graphics tablet with a 10 x 6.25 in. drawing area. Its battery-free stylus has 16,384 pressure levels and supports up to 60° of tilt, per the listing. Eight customizable shortcut keys work for right- or left-handed users. It connects over USB-C (with adapters) and is compatible with Windows, macOS, ChromeOS, Linux and Android 10+, and works with Photoshop, Illustrator, Clip Studio and more. It's 8 mm thin. The box includes a pen stand with replacement nibs, a drawing glove and a protective film.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the affordable way to start drawing digitally properly, with pressure-sensitive lines a mouse can't do, and it slides into a laptop bag.
highlights: USB-C; Windows, Mac, ChromeOS, Linux, Android

name: Nintendo Switch Lite, Turquoise
shortDescription: Nintendo's compact, handheld-only Switch with built-in controls, online and local wireless multiplayer, and 32 GB of storage expandable via microSD.
description: The Nintendo Switch Lite is a compact, lightweight handheld version of the Switch with the controls built in, per the listing. It plays the Switch game library in handheld mode and supports online and local wireless multiplayer. It has 32 GB of storage, expandable with a microSDXC card. This is the turquoise color.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the travel console: pocketable, durable, and home to Mario, Zelda and Pokémon for flights and long drives.
highlights: Plays Switch library in handheld mode

name: Lodge 12-Inch Pre-Seasoned Cast Iron Skillet
shortDescription: The classic American cast-iron skillet, pre-seasoned with vegetable oil and PFAS-free, with a red silicone handle holder, made in the USA.
description: The Lodge 12-inch skillet is pre-seasoned with 100% natural vegetable oil for a naturally non-stick finish and is PFAS-free, per the listing. Cast iron distributes heat evenly and works for searing, sautéing, baking, frying, oven, grill and campfire cooking. It comes with a silicone heat-resistant handle holder and has a teardrop handle. It's made in the USA.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the one pan that gets better with age and outlives everything else in the kitchen, from stovetop steak to campfire cornbread.

name: PYEF CRAFTS DIY Closed Terrarium Kit, 34 oz
shortDescription: A complete kit for building a self-sustaining closed terrarium in a 1-liter cork-lidded glass jar, with soil, moss, charcoal, stones and bamboo tools (plant not included).
description: This kit contains everything to build a closed-jar terrarium except the plant: a 34 fl oz (1 L) glass jar with cork lid, coconut soil, decorative stones, sphagnum moss, activated charcoal, bamboo tweezers, a bamboo spoon and step-by-step instructions, pre-measured for the jar, per the listing. It suggests Fittonia, mini ferns, air plants or moss. Once sealed, the jar recycles its moisture through condensation, so it needs very little watering. The jar measures about 4.3 x 4.3 x 8.3 in.
whyWeLikeIt: Building a tiny sealed world in a jar is a calming hands-on project, and the result is a living desk decoration that mostly looks after itself.
highlights: 34 fl oz (1 L) glass jar with cork lid

name: Ninja Foodi 5-in-1 XL Indoor Grill & Air Fryer (AG301)
shortDescription: A countertop indoor grill that sears with a 500°F grate and cyclonic hot air, and also air fries, roasts, bakes and dehydrates.
description: The Ninja Foodi AG301 grills, air fries, roasts, bakes and dehydrates. It combines a 500°F grill grate with 500°F cyclonic air circulation for char-grill marks indoors, and the listing says it can take frozen steaks, chicken, burgers or fish to grilled in under 25 minutes. It includes a 10 x 10 in. ceramic-coated grill grate, a 4-qt crisper basket and a 6-qt cooking pot, all nonstick, PTFE/PFOA-free and dishwasher safe, plus a 15-recipe book and cleaning brush. It's 1760 W.
whyWeLikeIt: Real grill marks in an apartment kitchen in January is the whole appeal, and it replaces an air fryer while it's at it.
highlights: Grill, air fry, roast, bake, dehydrate

name: Logitech MX Keys S Wireless Keyboard, Graphite
shortDescription: A low-profile wireless keyboard with dished keys, smart backlighting that wakes as your hands approach, 3-device switching and USB-C charging.
description: The Logitech MX Keys S has a laptop-like low profile with spherically dished keys for quieter, precise typing, per the listing. Its backlighting turns on as your hands approach and adapts to ambient light. It pairs with up to 3 devices on Windows, macOS or Linux via Bluetooth Low Energy or the included Logi Bolt receiver. Smart Actions in the Logi Options+ app automate multi-step tasks from one key. It charges via USB-C and lasts up to 10 days with backlight, or up to 5 months with it off. This is the graphite color.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the keyboard that makes a desk feel premium without going mechanical, and switching between laptop and desktop with one key is a daily convenience.
highlights: USB-C; up to 10 days (5 months backlight off)

name: HyperX QuadCast 2 S USB Microphone with RGB
shortDescription: A USB-C streaming microphone with 100+ customizable RGB LEDs, tap-to-mute, four polar patterns, a multifunction knob and a detachable shock mount.
description: The HyperX QuadCast 2 S is a USB-C microphone for streaming, podcasting and gaming. It has over 100 individually customizable aRGB LEDs, a tap-to-mute sensor on top, and a multifunction knob for gain, headphone volume, monitor mix and polar pattern, per the listing. It offers four polar patterns: cardioid, omnidirectional, bi-directional and stereo. The shock mount detaches via spring-loaded pins and fits 3/8 in. and 5/8 in. threads. An LED VU meter shows levels and status. It includes USB-C to USB-C and USB-C to USB-A cables/adapters.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the mic that makes a streaming setup look the part while sounding clean, and tap-to-mute is exactly where your hand wants it to be.

name: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4 Waterproof Speaker, Blue
shortDescription: A small 360° Bluetooth speaker that's waterproof, dustproof and floats, with 14 hours of playtime, Outdoor Boost and stereo pairing.
description: The WONDERBOOM 4 plays 360° sound from a compact body with up to 14 hours of battery, per the listing. It's IP67 rated (submersible in 1 m of water for 30 minutes), dustproof, drop-proof, and it floats. Outdoor Boost raises volume outside, Podcast Mode clarifies voices, and two units pair for stereo. Bluetooth range is 131 ft (40 m). It charges via USB-C (cable not included) and has a carry loop. Plastic parts include at least 31% recycled plastic. This is the blue color.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the speaker you don't worry about: toss it in the pool, the sand or the shower. Small enough for any bag.

name: Brother P-touch PTD220 Label Maker
shortDescription: A handheld QWERTY label maker for laminated 1/2-inch TZe tapes, with 14 fonts, 99 frames, 600+ symbols and memory for 30 labels.
description: The Brother P-touch PTD220 prints laminated labels up to about 1/2 inch (12 mm) wide on Brother TZe tapes, with one or two lines of text, per the listing. It has a QWERTY keyboard, 14 fonts, 11 font styles, 99 frames, over 600 symbols and 25 preset templates. It stores up to 30 frequently used labels. It runs on 6 AAA batteries or an optional AC adapter, both sold separately. It weighs about 1.1 lb.
whyWeLikeIt: Labeled pantry jars, cables and storage bins are what make an organized space stay organized, and this is the classic tool for it.
highlights: Laminated labels up to ~1/2 in. (TZe tapes)

name: Spikeball Original Roundnet 3-Ball Set
shortDescription: The original roundnet game set: a trampoline-style net, 3 balls, a drawstring bag and rules, playable on grass, sand or indoors.
description: Spikeball is a 2-on-2 game played by hitting a ball down onto a small round net so it bounces up to the other team. This set includes the net, 3 Spikeball balls, a drawstring carry bag and a rulebook, per the listing. It sets up quickly and can be played on grass, sand or indoors. This is the black/yellow single set.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the game that shows up at every park and beach once one person owns it: fast, competitive, and it packs into a bag.
highlights: Plays on grass, sand or indoors

name: GoSports 4 x 2 ft Rustic Portable Cornhole Set
shortDescription: A regulation-size cornhole set with two 4 x 2 ft barnwood-style boards, 8 bean bags and a carry case the boards fold into.
description: This GoSports set includes two regulation-size 4 x 2 ft boards with a printed barnwood design on steel frames, eight all-weather regulation bean bags (6 x 6 in., 1 lb each; 4 red, 4 blue), a carrying case and game rules, per the listing. The boards are MDF composite and weigh about 16 lb each, and both fold flat into the case for storage or transport.
whyWeLikeIt: Cornhole is the easiest backyard game to get everyone playing, with a drink in one hand, and this set looks good leaning against a garage wall.

name: Withings Body Smart Wi-Fi Scale, Black
shortDescription: A Wi-Fi and Bluetooth smart scale with a color display that tracks weight to 50 g, body composition and heart rate at each weigh-in, and syncs with Apple Health.
description: The Withings Body Smart is a connected bathroom scale. It tracks weight to within 50 g and shows weight trends on its high-resolution color display, per the listing. It also estimates body composition (including body fat, muscle mass and bone mass) and measures heart rate at every weigh-in, and estimates daily energy needs. It connects over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and is compatible with Apple Health. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns stepping on a scale into a trend line you can actually use, synced automatically, with no manual logging.

name: DREO 1500W Ceramic Space Heater with Thermostat, Gold
shortDescription: A quiet 1500 W PTC ceramic space heater with a 41-95°F thermostat in 1° steps, tip-over protection, remote, 12-hour timer and 34 dB operation.
description: The DREO heater uses a 1500 W PTC ceramic element with a heat-funnel design to spread warm air, per the listing. A thermostat sets 41-95°F in 1°F increments. It includes tilt-detection tip-over protection, overheat protection, V0 flame-retardant materials and a safety plug. A brushless DC motor keeps it to about 34 dB. It has Power, ECO and Fan Only modes, a remote, a 12-hour timer, mute, child lock and a carry handle. This is the gold 10-inch model.
whyWeLikeIt: A quiet, precise heater under a desk or in a bedroom means you can keep the whole house cooler, and the remote means not getting up to adjust it.

name: PONPUR Globe Whiskey Decanter Set with Glasses & Chilling Balls
shortDescription: An 850 ml hand-blown globe decanter with an etched world map and a tiny ship inside, on a wooden stand, with two map glasses and two chilling balls.
description: This PONPUR set centers on an 850 ml (28 oz) lead-free glass globe decanter with an etched world map and a detailed antique ship inside, which rotates on its axis on a wooden tray, per the listing. It includes a bottle stopper, a pouring funnel, two 230 ml engraved world-map glasses and two reusable stainless chilling balls for drinks without diluting ice. The set measures about 10 x 4 x 6 in.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a statement piece on a home bar: the tiny ship inside the globe gets noticed by every guest. One of the most popular whiskey gifts for a reason.

name: Craft A Brew Oktoberfest Ale 1-Gallon Beer Making Kit
shortDescription: A complete 1-gallon home-brewing starter kit with equipment, ingredients and a brewing guide for a malty Oktoberfest-style ale.
description: Craft A Brew's Oktoberfest Ale kit includes the equipment and supplies to brew one gallon of beer at home, plus the Craft a Brew Guide to Craft Brewing for first-timers, per the listing. The recipe is described as a light-red, malty ale with subtle bitterness, caramel sweetness and a dry finish. Kits are assembled by hand in Orlando, Florida.
whyWeLikeIt: Brewing your own beer is a fun weekend project with a genuinely rewarding result, and the one-gallon size fits in a small kitchen.

name: SoftOwl Premium Soy Candle Making Kit
shortDescription: A beginner-friendly candle-making set with soy wax, jars and tins, 7 fragrance oils, 10 dye blocks, wicks, a melting pot and labels in a gift box.
description: The SoftOwl kit includes soy wax, candle jars and tin cans, 7 fragrance oils, 10 color dye blocks, wicks, glue dots, a melting pot, pipettes, stirring spoons and labels, plus dried flowers for decoration, per the listing. It's designed for beginners with simple instructions and comes in a giftable box.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a relaxing creative project whose results double as gifts, and choosing your own scent and color is the fun part.

name: Azul Board Game
shortDescription: The 2018 Spiel des Jahres winner: draft colorful resin tiles to build a Portuguese-style mosaic wall, for 2-4 players in 30-45 minutes.
description: In Azul, players draft tiles from shared factory displays to complete pattern rows and build a mosaic wall inspired by Portuguese azulejos, per the listing. It won the 2018 Spiel des Jahres. It plays 2-4 players ages 8+ in 30-45 minutes and works especially well as a two-player game. It includes 100 resin tiles, 4 player boards, 9 factory displays, scoring markers, a starting player marker and a linen bag.
whyWeLikeIt: The chunky, candy-like tiles make it a joy to handle, and it's easy enough for non-gamers while still rewarding strategy.

name: CUTEBEE Book Nook Kit, Owl Bookstore
shortDescription: A DIY miniature wooden diorama of a Renaissance-style bookstore that slots between books on a shelf, built in about 1-2 hours.
description: The CUTEBEE Owl Bookstore book nook is a DIY miniature scene that stands on a bookshelf like a book. It depicts a Renaissance-inspired bookstore with dark wood shelves, table lamps and paintings, and assembles in about 1-2 hours using the illustrated manual, per the listing. Parts are wood and paper. It measures about 27.5 x 19.2 x 3.7 cm. It's recommended for ages 14+, and the listing notes silicone glue is needed.
whyWeLikeIt: A book nook turns a bookshelf into a tiny world you can peer into, and building it is a calming evening project.
highlights: Stands between books on a shelf

name: MTEN USAPA-Approved Fiberglass Pickleball Paddle Set, 2-Pack
shortDescription: A set of two USA Pickleball-approved fiberglass paddles with polypropylene honeycomb cores and cushioned grips, plus balls, grip tapes and a carry bag.
description: The MTEN set includes two pickleball paddles that are USA Pickleball (USAPA) approved for tournament use, per the listing. Each has a fiberglass face over a polypropylene honeycomb core, a perforated cushioned grip with a 4.57 in. circumference, and weighs about 7.8 oz (medium weight). The set includes a carry bag, 2 grip tapes and 4 outdoor balls. This is the black 2-paddle set.
whyWeLikeIt: Pickleball is the easiest racket sport to pick up, and this is a complete starter set for two people in one bag.

name: Lamicall Lockable Bike & Motorcycle Phone Mount
shortDescription: A one-hand handlebar phone holder that grips all four corners with a locking switch, fits 4.7-6.8 in. phones and 15-40 mm bars, tool-free.
description: The Lamicall mount clamps to bicycle, motorcycle or stroller handlebars from 15 to 40 mm diameter without tools, using included silicone pads to fit, per the listing. Its corner grips hold phones from 4.7 to 6.8 in. and up to 15 mm thick including a case, and a red switch on the back locks the clip. Silicone pads cushion the phone, and it rotates between portrait and landscape. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: Navigation on a bike or scooter without holding the phone makes rides safer and easier, and the lock stops it launching over bumps.

name: Bee's Wrap Beeswax Wrap Roll, 14 x 53 in, Honeycomb
shortDescription: A large cut-to-size roll of reusable beeswax food wrap, made in the USA from beeswax, organic plant oils and tree resin.
description: This Bee's Wrap roll measures 14 x 53 in. and can be cut to size for bread, sandwiches, bowl covers and produce, per the listing. It's made from beeswax, organic plant oils and natural tree resin, and it's breathable, washable by hand and reusable, then compostable at the end of its life. It's made in the USA. This is the honeycomb pattern XXL roll.
whyWeLikeIt: It replaces rolls of plastic wrap with something that looks nice and lasts, and cutting your own sizes means nothing goes to waste.
highlights: Beeswax, organic plant oils, tree resin

name: Surebonder Cordless High-Temp Hot Glue Gun, 60W
shortDescription: A full-size 60 W hot glue gun that reaches 380°F and can be used cordless for a few minutes off its heating base, or corded indefinitely.
description: The Surebonder CL-800F is a full-size high-temperature glue gun that reaches 380°F for bonding metal, wood, ceramics, leather and other materials, per the listing. It sits on a heating base that keeps it warm, can be used for up to 3 minutes off the base cordless, or indefinitely with the 5 ft cord attached. Its 60 W capacity supports continuous glue flow. Safety features include a fuse, an insulated nozzle and side fins that stop glue backing up when the gun is laid down. A mini glue pad is included.
whyWeLikeIt: Cordless means no cable dragging across the project, which makes crafts and quick home fixes much less fiddly.
highlights: Cordless up to 3 min; corded indefinitely

name: Deluxe Hot Sauce Making Kit, Ghost Pepper Edition
shortDescription: A DIY hot sauce gift kit with four dried peppers including ghost pepper, a gourmet spice blend, bottles, labels and a 31-page recipe booklet.
description: This millhouse spice co. kit contains everything to make and bottle your own hot sauce: dried chipotle, habanero, cayenne and ghost peppers, a gourmet spice blend, apple cider vinegar, glass bottles and caps, customizable labels, a stainless-steel funnel, pH test strips and gloves, per the listing. A 31-page booklet has quick recipes, and the kit makes up to 10 bottles. It's made and packed in the USA in a gift box.
whyWeLikeIt: Bottling your own hot sauce with custom labels is a great afternoon project, and the ghost pepper option satisfies serious chili fans.

name: Samsung T7 Portable SSD 1TB
shortDescription: A pocket-size 1TB solid-state drive with USB 3.2 Gen 2 and read/write speeds up to 1,050/1,000 MB/s.
description: Samsung's T7 uses PCIe NVMe technology inside a compact aluminum unibody for sequential read and write speeds up to 1,050 and 1,000 MB/s, per the listing. It works across PCs, Macs, phones, tablets and gaming consoles, can record 4K 60fps video directly from supported cameras and phones, and is rated for drops of up to 6 feet. This is the 1TB Titan Gray version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a fast, tough backup drive small enough to live in a laptop bag, and it's just as handy for moving game libraries or phone video.

name: FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M 3D Printer
shortDescription: A fast Core XY 3D printer with one-click automatic bed leveling, a quick-swap 280°C nozzle and a 220 x 220 x 220 mm build volume.
description: The Adventurer 5M uses a Core XY motion system rated for up to 600 mm/s print speed and 20,000 mm/s² acceleration, per the listing.
