shortDescription: An extra-large 84 x 40 inch rectangular sleeping bag rated to 10°F, with a cotton cover, flannel liner and 5 lbs of Holofill insulation.
description: Coleman's Heritage Big & Tall sleeping bag measures 84 x 40 inches and is rated to 10°F, per the listing. It's filled with 5 pounds of Holofill 808 insulation, uses FiberLock to keep the fill from shifting, and has a heavy-duty cotton cover with a synthetic flannel liner. A no-snag zipper and the Wrap 'N' Roll system make it easy to use and pack, and it's machine washable.
whyWeLikeIt: Roomy, warm and cozy, it's just as useful for cold campsites as it is for guests sleeping over.

name: LEVOIT Classic 160 Top-Fill Cool Mist Humidifier, 2.5L
shortDescription: A 2.5-liter top-fill cool mist humidifier that runs up to 25 hours on low, with a one-knob mist control and 360° nozzle.
description: The LEVOIT Classic 160 holds 2.5 liters and runs up to 25 hours on its low setting, per the listing. The top-fill design means no flipping the tank, and the large opening and simple base make cleaning easy. A single knob adjusts mist output, the nozzle rotates 360°, it operates at around 25 dB, and it shuts off automatically when the tank is empty. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: Top-filling is a genuine convenience, and it runs quietly enough to leave on overnight.

name: Flexzilla Garden Hose, 5/8 in. x 50 ft
shortDescription: A lightweight 50 ft hybrid-polymer garden hose that lays flat, resists kinking and has crush-resistant aluminum fittings.
description: Flexzilla's 5/8 in. x 50 ft garden hose is made of a hybrid polymer that stays flexible in all weather, won't kink under pressure, coils easily and lays flat, per the listing. It has an abrasion-resistant outer cover and crush-resistant anodized aircraft aluminum fittings, is lighter than traditional hoses and is rated to 150 psi. It's made in the USA in the signature Chartreuse color.
whyWeLikeIt: A hose that doesn't kink or fight you makes watering and washing the car far less frustrating.

name: MATEIN Travel Laptop Backpack, 15.6 Inch, Grey
shortDescription: A personal-item size laptop backpack with a 15.6-inch laptop compartment, a luggage strap and a hidden anti-theft pocket.
description: The MATEIN travel backpack has a separate compartment for laptops up to 15.6 inches and a main compartment for daily essentials, per the listing. At about 18 x 12 x 7.8 inches, it's sized as a personal item for most airlines. A luggage strap slides over a suitcase handle, a hidden pocket on the back holds valuables, and the padded, ventilated back panel adds comfort. It's water-resistant polyester with metal zippers. This is the grey version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an affordable, organized bag that works equally well for flights, commutes and school.

name: Coleman Sundome 4-Person Camping Tent with Rainfly
shortDescription: A classic 4-person dome tent that sets up in about 10 minutes, with a rainfly, large windows, a ground vent and an E-Port.
description: The Coleman Sundome is a 4-person dome tent that sets up in about 10 minutes, per the listing. Its included rainfly adds weather protection, and the frame is rated to withstand 35+ mph winds. Large windows and a ground vent provide airflow, and an E-Port lets you bring an extension cord inside. It has a 7-foot floor width and weighs about 9.1 pounds. This is the Navy Blue version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an easy, dependable first tent for family campouts, festivals and backyard sleepovers.

name: Wmcaps Bluetooth Beanie with LED Light, Grey
shortDescription: A knit winter beanie with built-in Bluetooth 5.0 headphones, a microphone and a removable rechargeable LED headlight.
description: This Wmcaps beanie combines a hat, headphones and a light, per the listing. Bluetooth 5.0 pairs with phones up to about 33 feet away, and a built-in microphone handles calls. The removable, USB-rechargeable LED light has three brightness settings and lights up to about 30 feet ahead. The electronics are removable so the soft acrylic-polyester knit can be washed. This is the grey version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a fun, practical gift for early-morning runners, dog walkers and anyone who's out after dark in winter.

name: Yankee Candle Autumn Leaves Large Jar Candle, 22 oz
shortDescription: A 22 oz Yankee Candle large jar in Autumn Leaves, with up to 150 hours of burn time.
description: Yankee Candle's Autumn Leaves scent blends birch and maple leaves, fall fruits and a hint of orange blossom, per the listing. The 22 oz large jar uses a premium plant wax blend and a natural-fiber wick, and is rated for up to 150 hours of burn time. It measures about 4 x 6.8 inches.
whyWeLikeIt: A classic large jar candle is an easy seasonal gift, and it lasts for weeks of cozy evenings.

name: nutribullet Pro 900W Personal Blender, Matte White
shortDescription: A 900-watt personal blender with 32 oz and 24 oz cups, a flip-top travel lid and stainless steel extractor blades.
description: The nutribullet Pro has a 900-watt motor that blends dense ingredients like nuts, seeds, hard fruits and kale, per the listing. It uses a simple push-and-twist operation with stainless steel extractor blades, and comes with a 32 oz cup, a 24 oz cup and a flip-top to-go lid. The blades twist off for rinsing, and the cups are top-rack dishwasher safe. This is the Matte White model NB9-0901AW.
whyWeLikeIt: Blending straight into a cup you can carry out the door makes morning smoothies quick and easy.

name: Furhaven Cooling Gel Sofa Dog Bed, Jumbo, Granite Gray
shortDescription: A sofa-style dog bed for large dogs up to 95 lbs, with a cooling gel-top foam base, bolsters and a removable, machine-washable cover.
description: This Furhaven sofa bed has a gel-top foam layer over a solid foam base, with bolstered sides for dogs who like to lean or curl up, per the listing. It's sized for large dogs up to 95 lbs and measures about 40 x 32 x 9.5 inches. The zippered cover is removable and machine washable, and the foam is CertiPUR-US certified. This is the Jumbo size in Granite Gray plush and velvet.
whyWeLikeIt: Bolsters give big dogs a place to rest their heads, and the washable cover keeps it fresh with minimal effort.

name: Stomp Rocket Ultra Launcher with 4 Rockets
shortDescription: The original kid-powered foam rocket launcher: stomp the pad to send soft-tipped rockets up to 200 feet, with no batteries needed.
description: Stomp Rocket Ultra is 100% kid-powered: stomp on the air pad and the foam-tipped rockets launch up to 200 feet, per the listing. The adjustable launch stand sends rockets straight up or across the yard, there are no batteries or cords, and the durable base assembles easily. This set includes the launcher and 4 rockets, for ages 5 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: It gets kids running around outside for hours, and it's a classic backyard and birthday-party toy.

name: Weber Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill, 22-Inch
shortDescription: Weber's classic 22-inch charcoal kettle with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid, a lid thermometer and the One-Touch ash cleaning system.
description: The Weber Original Kettle Premium has room for up to 13 burgers on its plated steel cooking grate, per the listing. The porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat and resist rust, the One-Touch cleaning system empties into a removable high-capacity ash catcher, and a built-in lid thermometer shows the temperature. It adds glass-reinforced nylon handles, an aluminum damper for airflow, an angled lid hook and all-weather wheels.
whyWeLikeIt: The Weber kettle is the classic charcoal grill for a reason, and it's simple to master for burgers or low-and-slow cooking.

name: Fit Simplify Resistance Loop Exercise Bands, Set of 5
shortDescription: A set of five 12 x 2 inch latex loop bands in color-coded resistance levels, with a carry bag and an instruction guide.
description: Fit Simplify's set includes five 12 x 2 inch loop bands in five color-coded resistance levels, per the listing. They can be used for strength training, stretching and general exercise, and the set comes with a portable carry bag and an instruction guide. The bands are latex.
whyWeLikeIt: They weigh almost nothing and pack into a pocket-size bag, making it easy to work out at home or while traveling.

name: Spirograph Design Set Collector's Tin
shortDescription: The classic Spirograph drawing set in a collector's tin, with 9 shapes, 2 pens, putty, a design booklet and a design pad.
description: Spirograph combines art and geometry to draw intricate spiral designs, per the listing. This collector's tin includes 9 shapes, 2 retractable pens (red and blue), a 10-page design booklet, a 24-page design pad and Spirograph putty, all stored in a snap-in tray. It's compatible with other Spirograph sets and is recommended for ages 8 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a screen-free classic that still amazes kids, and adults tend to enjoy it just as much.

name: Manta Sleep Mask
shortDescription: An adjustable blackout sleep mask with detachable, deeply molded eye cups that put no pressure on the eyes or lashes.
description: The Manta Sleep Mask uses deeply molded eye cups that cover and conform around the eyes to block light, per the listing. The eye cups' position and angle and the strap tightness are all adjustable, and the mask puts zero pressure on eyes or lashes, so it works for back and stomach sleepers. It's made of soft, breathable materials and is fully machine washable. This is the gray version.
whyWeLikeIt: A mask that really blocks light makes a real difference on flights and for anyone who sleeps while it's bright outside.

name: Strider 12" Classic Balance Bike, Blue
shortDescription: A no-pedal 12-inch balance bike for ages 1-3 with a built-in footrest, flat-free tires and tool-free seat and handlebar adjustment.
description: The Strider 12" Classic has a painted steel frame, a built-in footrest and flat-free tires, per the listing. The seat adjusts from 11 to 16 inches (for inseams of about 12 to 17 inches) and the handlebars adjust too, all without tools. As a balance bike, it lets toddlers stride and practice steering and balance before moving to a pedal bike. This is the blue version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a simple, sturdy first bike that toddlers can ride right away, and it grows with them for a few years.

name: EHEYCIGA L-Shaped Cardboard Cat Scratcher, 26.8 Inch
shortDescription: An L-shaped corrugated cardboard cat scratcher that stands against a wall or sofa, with a ball toy included.
description: This EHEYCIGA scratcher is made of dense, non-toxic corrugated paper in an L-shaped design that sits against a wall or sofa, giving cats both vertical and horizontal surfaces, per the listing. Cats can scratch, stretch and lounge on it, and it includes a ball toy. It measures about 16.6 x 11.2 x 26.8 inches and comes with tools and instructions for setup.
whyWeLikeIt: Giving cats a tall scratching spot next to the sofa is one of the easiest ways to save the furniture.

name: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 Portable Power Station
shortDescription: A 2042Wh LiFePO4 portable power station with 2200W AC output, 66-minute fast charging to 80% and seamless UPS switching.
description: The Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 stores 2042Wh and delivers 2200W across 3 AC outlets, per the listing. At 39.5 lbs it's compact for its capacity, and AC fast charging reaches 80% in about 66 minutes (full in 102 minutes). It uses a LiFePO4 battery rated to last up to 10 years, runs as quiet as under 30 dB in silent charging mode, and switches over in 20 ms as an uninterruptible power supply during outages.
whyWeLikeIt: It can run essentials through a power outage or power a whole campsite, and it recharges quickly between trips.

name: GoSports 90mm Resin Bocce Ball Set
shortDescription: A full backyard bocce set with 8 high-gloss resin balls, a pallino, a measuring rope and a carry case.
description: GoSports' bocce set uses 90 mm high-grade resin balls that weigh about 1 lb 10 oz each, close to regulation size, per the listing. It includes 8 balls, a pallino, a measuring rope, a carry case and rules, and can be played on grass, sand or bocce courts.
whyWeLikeIt: Bocce is easy for any age to pick up, which makes it a perfect game for parties, picnics and beach days.

name: THERMOS FUNTAINER 10 oz Kids Food Jar, Navy
shortDescription: A 10 oz vacuum-insulated stainless steel food jar for kids, with a push-button lid and a folding spoon.
description: The THERMOS FUNTAINER keeps food hot for up to 5 hours or cold for up to 7 hours with vacuum insulation, per the listing. It's made of 18/8 stainless steel for everyday durability, with a lightweight, compact body, an easy push-button lid and an integrated folding spoon. Prefilling with hot or cold water for a few minutes helps it hold temperature. This is the 10 oz Navy version.
whyWeLikeIt: It means a warm lunch at school without a microwave, and it's tough enough for daily backpack life.

name: Dachenus Indoor Putting Green Mat with Ball Return
shortDescription: A roll-out velvet putting green with two practice holes, distance markings and an automatic ball return in a solid wood frame.
description: The Dachenus putting mat rolls out quickly and snaps together with a magnetic ball-return track, per the listing. It's marked at 2, 4, 6 and 9.5 feet and has two holes, including a smaller 2.5-inch hole for precision practice. The solid wood frame is hand-polished, and the wrinkle-free velvet surface rolls up for storage. This is the light green version.
whyWeLikeIt: It lets golfers sneak in putting practice at home or in the office, and it makes a great gift for any golf fan.

name: Sunbeam Royal Ultra Heated Throw, Rodeen Blue Plaid
shortDescription: A 50 x 60 inch heated fleece throw with 4 heat settings, a push-button controller and a 4-hour auto shut-off.
description: Sunbeam's Royal Ultra heated throw measures 50 x 60 inches in soft royal ultra fleece, per the listing. A simple push-button controller with LED indicators offers 4 heat settings (warm, low, medium and high), and it has a 4-hour auto shut-off and overheat protection. It's 100% polyester in the Rodeen Blue Plaid pattern.
whyWeLikeIt: A heated throw makes the couch the coziest place in the house on cold evenings, and it's a thoughtful winter gift.

name: Cascade Mountain Tech Aluminum Trekking Poles with Cork Grips
shortDescription: A pair of 10 oz aircraft-grade aluminum trekking poles with cork grips, quick locks, extended down grips and an accessory kit.
description: Cascade Mountain Tech's trekking poles are made of aircraft-grade 6061 aluminum and weigh about 10 ounces each, per the listing. Quick lock mechanisms adjust them from 26 to 54 inches, and ergonomic cork grips are paired with extended EVA down grips. They include tungsten carbide tips, rubber boots and tip covers, snow and mud baskets, and a travel bag. This is the orange cork-grip Quick Lock version.
whyWeLikeIt: Poles make steep climbs and descents more comfortable, and this pair is a great value for day hikes and backpacking.

name: Discraft Ultra-Star 175g Sport Disc
shortDescription: The official 175-gram disc of USA Ultimate competition, with stable flight, good glide and a textured rim.
description: The Discraft Ultra-Star is the official disc of USA Ultimate-sanctioned competition and meets the official 175-gram standard, per the listing. It's engineered for stable, consistent flight and glide, holds its shape through hard play, and has a comfortable textured rim. It's white with a decorative foil stamp whose color varies.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the real thing for backyard, park and beach games, with a stable flight that makes throws easy to catch.

name: Zojirushi Stainless Steel Travel Mug, 16 oz, Black
shortDescription: A compact 16 oz vacuum-insulated stainless steel mug that holds 154°F after 6 hours, with a wide mouth.
description: Zojirushi's 16 oz stainless mug uses vacuum insulation and an 18/8 stainless steel interior, per the listing. Its heat retention is rated at 187°F after 1 hour and 154°F after 6 hours, and cold retention at 48°F after 6 hours. It has a wide mouth, a Slick Steel finish and a compact design. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the travel mug that keeps coffee hot for hours, and it's compact enough for any bag or cup holder.

name: Everlasting Comfort Memory Foam Seat Cushion, Large, Black
shortDescription: A U-shaped memory foam seat cushion for office chairs, car seats and travel, with a washable cover and non-slip bottom.
description: The Everlasting Comfort seat cushion is made of 100% memory foam with an ergonomic U-shaped cutout at the back, per the listing. It has a breathable, machine-washable cover and a non-slip bottom, and fits office chairs, car seats and airplane seats. This is the large black version.
whyWeLikeIt: A thick memory foam cushion makes a hard office chair or long drive noticeably more comfortable.

name: Amazon Smart Thermostat, 2-Pack
shortDescription: Two Amazon Smart Thermostats that work with Alexa and Ring, with schedules and automatic control (C-wire required).
description: This 2-pack includes two Amazon Smart Thermostats, an easy way to replace traditional thermostats, per the listing. They work with Alexa and Ring, support home, away and sleep schedules, and can let Alexa automatically adjust heating and cooling, including comfort zones based on temperature readings from select Alexa devices. They're ENERGY STAR certified and require a C-wire.
whyWeLikeIt: Two thermostats make sense for homes with more than one zone, and Alexa control means you can adjust the temperature by voice.

name: UBeesize 12" LED Ring Light with 62" Tripod
shortDescription: A 12-inch, 240-LED ring light on a 62-inch tripod that converts to a selfie stick, with a phone holder and Bluetooth remote.
description: The UBeesize ring light has 240 LEDs in a 12-inch ring, with touch controls for 5 color modes and 10 brightness levels, per the listing. It sits on a tripod that extends to 62 inches and converts into a handheld selfie stick, and the light head and phone holder rotate 360° for portrait, landscape or overhead shots. It's USB powered and includes a Bluetooth remote shutter.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an easy, affordable lighting upgrade for video calls, makeup, content creation and product photos.

name: Nordic Ware Naturals Aluminum Half Sheet Pans, 2-Pack
shortDescription: Two made-in-USA aluminum half sheet pans with encapsulated steel rims that resist warping.
description: Nordic Ware's Naturals half sheets are pure aluminum for even heat conduction and browning, per the listing. They won't rust, and encapsulated galvanized steel rims help prevent warping. Each pan measures 17.9 x 12.9 x 1 inches outside (17.1 x 12.1 inside). They're made in America of domestic and imported materials.
whyWeLikeIt: Sheet pans are the workhorse of any kitchen, and these are the sturdy, even-baking kind that last.

name: Alesis Recital 88-Key Digital Piano
shortDescription: A full-size 88-key semi-weighted digital piano with adjustable touch response, 5 voices, built-in 20W speakers and lesson modes.
description: The Alesis Recital has 88 full-sized semi-weighted keys with adjustable touch response, per the listing. It offers 5 voices (acoustic piano, electric piano, organ, synth and bass) with chorus and reverb, two built-in 20W speakers and 128-note polyphony. Standard, split, layer and lesson modes help beginners, and it has a sustain pedal input (pedal not included), a headphone output and RCA outputs. It runs from the included adapter or 6 D batteries, and includes trial subscriptions to Skoove and Melodics lessons.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a full-size keyboard at a beginner-friendly price, with headphone practice so nobody else has to listen to scales.

name: BLACK+DECKER dustbuster QuickClean Cordless Handheld Vacuum
shortDescription: A lightweight rechargeable handheld vacuum with a built-in crevice tool, a clear bagless bowl and a wall mount.
description: The BLACK+DECKER dustbuster QuickClean is a cordless, rechargeable handheld vacuum for quick cleanups around the house or in the car, per the listing. It has a built-in crevice tool for couch cushions and shelves, a transparent bagless dirt bowl so you can see when to empty it, and a wall mount for storage. This is the white HNVC215B10 model.
whyWeLikeIt: Keeping a handheld vacuum within reach makes crumbs, pet hair and car messes a 30-second job.

name: Zebra Mildliner Dual-Tip Highlighters, 15-Pack
shortDescription: A 15-pack of soft-color dual-tip highlighters with a broad chisel tip and a fine bullet tip on each pen.
description: Each Zebra Mildliner has a broad chisel tip for highlighting and a fine bullet tip for underlining and writing, per the listing. The soft, translucent ink is designed to minimize bleed-through on thin pages, and the water-resistant ink can be layered once dry. This pack includes 15 assorted colors with matching color-coded clips.
whyWeLikeIt: The gentle colors make notes and planners look great, which is why students, teachers and journalers love them.

name: Brita Large 10-Cup Water Filter Pitcher, White
shortDescription: A BPA-free 10-cup filter pitcher with an easy-fill locking lid that fits on refrigerator shelves, with one filter included.
description: The Brita Large pitcher holds 10 cups of water, enough to fill three 24 oz bottles, per the listing. It's BPA-free, sized to fit refrigerator shelves (about 10.5 inches tall), and has an easy-fill locking lid. It includes one filter and works with Brita Standard and Longlast filters; Brita says its filters reduce chlorine taste and odor. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: Keeping filtered water in the fridge is an easy swap for bottled water, and it's a simple, useful kitchen staple.

name: SteelSeries QcK XXL Gaming Mouse Pad, Black
shortDescription: A desk-size micro-woven cloth mouse pad that covers the keyboard and mouse area, with a non-slip rubber base.
description: The SteelSeries QcK XXL is a large micro-woven cloth surface that covers both keyboard and mouse, per the listing. Its high thread count is tested for optical and laser sensor tracking, and the non-slip rubber base keeps it in place. SteelSeries notes the QcK has been used by esports pros for 15 years. This is the black XXL version.
whyWeLikeIt: A full-desk pad instantly makes a setup look cleaner and gives the mouse room to move.

name: Estes Tandem-X Model Rocket Launch Set
shortDescription: A beginner model-rocket launch set with two rockets to build, a launch pad and a launch controller, for ages 10+.
description: The Estes Tandem-X set includes two rockets, the 30-inch Amazon model, projected to reach about 600 feet with a C6-5 engine, plus a launch pad and launch controller, per the listing. The Amazon model is precolored with plastic fins and self-stick graphics. Engines are sold separately, and the set is designed for use with the NAR model-rocket safety code. It's for ages 10+.
whyWeLikeIt: Building and launching a real model rocket is a memorable family project with a big payoff on launch day.

name: Edifier R1280T Powered Bookshelf Speakers, Black
shortDescription: A pair of 42W powered bookshelf speakers with two AUX inputs, bass and treble controls and a remote.
description: The Edifier R1280T pairs a 13mm silk dome tweeter with a 4-inch full-range driver in each speaker, per the listing, for 42W RMS total. Two inputs (3.5mm and RCA) let you connect two devices at once, side-panel knobs adjust bass and treble, and a remote controls volume. The cabinets are MDF. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: They're a big step up from laptop or TV speakers, and a classic choice for a desk or record-player setup.

name: Iron Gym Total Upper Body Doorway Pull-Up Bar
shortDescription: A no-screw doorway pull-up bar with wide, narrow and neutral grips that fits door frames up to 35.4 inches wide.
description: The Iron Gym Total Upper Body Workout Bar hangs on a doorway without screws, per the listing. It offers wide, narrow and neutral grip positions with comfort foam handgrips, is built of heavy-duty steel and is rated up to 300 pounds. It fits door frames up to 35.4 inches wide.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns any doorway into a pull-up station, and it comes down in seconds when you're done.

name: Rummikub Classic Tile Game
shortDescription: The classic rummy-style tile game for 2-4 players ages 8+: place numbered tiles in runs and groups to be first to go out.
description: In Rummikub, players take turns placing numbered tiles in runs or groups, rummy style, and the first to use all their tiles wins, per the listing. It's fast-paced and easy to learn for players of different ages, and it exercises sequencing, pattern recognition and planning. It's for 2-4 players ages 8 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a timeless game that grandparents and kids can enjoy together, and a round only takes a few minutes to learn.

name: AstroAI DM130B Digital Multimeter
shortDescription: An auto-ranging 4000-count multimeter for AC/DC voltage, current, resistance, continuity, capacitance and battery tests, with a backlit screen.
description: The AstroAI DM130B measures AC/DC voltage and current, resistance, continuity and capacitance, and tests diodes and batteries, per the listing. It's auto-ranging with 4000 counts, has non-contact voltage detection, data hold, a large backlit LCD, a kickstand and a low-battery indicator. Two fuses (F500mA/600V and F10A/600V) and protection circuits are built in. This is the red version.
whyWeLikeIt: A multimeter is the first tool for troubleshooting outlets, batteries and car electrics, and this one is simple for beginners.

name: Stasher Reusable Silicone Storage Bags, 4-Pack, Clear
shortDescription: A 4-pack of platinum food-grade silicone storage bags with a leak-free Pinch-Loc seal: one half gallon, two sandwich and one snack size.
description: This Stasher set includes one half-gallon (64 fl oz), two sandwich (28 fl oz) and one snack (12 fl oz) bag, per the listing. They're made of platinum food-grade silicone with a leak-free Pinch-Loc seal and are free of lead, latex and phthalates. The bags are dishwasher safe and can be used for meal prep, travel and more, and Stasher covers them with a lifetime warranty. This is the clear set.
whyWeLikeIt: They replace a drawer full of single-use bags, and the sturdy seal makes them great for snacks, leftovers and travel toiletries.

name: Audio-Technica ATH-M50x Professional Studio Headphones, Black
shortDescription: Classic over-ear studio monitor headphones with 45mm drivers, 90° swiveling earcups and a detachable cable.
description: The ATH-M50x uses proprietary 45 mm large-aperture drivers with rare earth magnets and copper-clad aluminum voice coils for clarity across an extended frequency range and deep, accurate bass, per the listing. The circumaural earcups isolate sound in loud environments and swivel 90° for one-ear monitoring, and the earpads and headband use professional-grade materials. They come with a detachable cable. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: They're a long-time favorite of musicians, podcasters and home studios, and just as good for everyday listening.

name: Snark SN5X Clip-On Chromatic Tuner
shortDescription: A clip-on chromatic tuner with a full-color display for guitar and bass that mounts on the front or back of the headstock.
description: The Snark SN5X is a clip-on chromatic tuner with a full-color display and a frequency range tailored to guitar and bass, per the listing. It can be clipped to the front or back of the headstock and weighs about 1.6 ounces. A battery is included. This is the black SN5X version.
whyWeLikeIt: A reliable clip-on tuner is the most useful accessory for any guitarist, and it pairs well with a ukulele or guitar gift.

name: Tulip One-Step Tie Dye Party Kit, 18 Bottles
shortDescription: A big group tie-dye kit with 18 pre-filled bottles in 14 colors, gloves, rubber bands and project guides for up to 36 projects.
description: Tulip's party kit includes 18 easy-squeeze bottles of One-Step Tie-Dye in 14 colors, plus gloves, rubber bands and project guides, per the listing. There's no presoaking in soda ash: just add water to the bottles, shake and apply. It makes up to 36 projects and works best on cotton, rayon and wool, like T-shirts, sweatshirts, bags and socks.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a birthday party or summer afternoon into a hands-on project everyone gets to take home.

name: KVR Garden Kneeler and Seat with Tool Pouches
shortDescription: A foldable garden stool that flips into a padded kneeler, with a widened pad, two tool pouches and a 330 lb capacity.
description: The KVR garden kneeler works as a seat when upright or a kneeling pad when flipped over, per the listing. The pad is widened to about 7.9 inches, the frame folds compactly for carrying and storage, and it supports up to 330 lbs. Two large tool pouches keep gardening tools within reach. This is the green version.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes weeding and planting more comfortable, and it's a thoughtful gift for any gardener.

name: ChomChom Roller Reusable Pet Hair Remover
shortDescription: A reusable, no-adhesive roller that traps pet hair and lint from couches, bedding, rugs and car seats into a built-in bin.
description: The ChomChom Roller picks up dog and cat hair when rolled back and forth over fabric surfaces like couches, pillows, bedding, rugs and car seats, per the listing. The hair collects in a built-in receptacle that empties with the press of a release button. It uses no adhesive sheets or tape, so it can be reused again and again. This is the white original-size version.
whyWeLikeIt: It clears a hairy couch in a minute without buying refills, which pet owners appreciate.

name: Amazon Fire HD 10 Tablet, 32 GB, Black
shortDescription: A 10.1-inch 1080p tablet with an octa-core processor, up to 13 hours of battery, a 5 MP front camera and stylus support.
description: The latest Fire HD 10 has a 10.1-inch 1080p Full HD display and is described as 25% faster than the previous generation, per the listing. It offers up to 13 hours of battery, 3 or 4 GB of RAM, a durable design with aluminosilicate glass, and a 5 MP front camera for video calls. It supports the Made for Amazon Stylus Pen (sold separately) with 4,096 pressure levels. This is the 32 GB black version with lockscreen ads.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an affordable big-screen tablet for streaming, reading and video calls, and it's great for travel.

name: JanSport SuperBreak One Backpack, Navy
shortDescription: The classic lightweight JanSport backpack with one main compartment, a front utility pocket with organizer and a web haul handle.
description: The JanSport SuperBreak One is made of durable 600-denier fabric that's abrasion resistant and water repellent, per the listing. It has one main compartment for books and notebooks, a front utility pocket with a built-in organizer, padded straps and a web haul handle. It's ultra-lightweight and comes in over 30 colors; this is the navy version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the dependable, simple backpack generations have carried, sized well for school, work and day trips.

name: Splendor Gem Trading Board Game
shortDescription: The engine-building game where 2-4 players collect gems, buy development cards and attract nobles to reach 15 prestige.
description: In Splendor, players collect gem tokens, purchase development cards and attract noble patrons to build an economic engine and race to 15 prestige points, per the listing. Each turn offers three possible actions, which makes it quick to teach. It's for 2-4 players ages 10+ and plays in about 30 minutes, with 40 tokens, 90 development cards and 10 noble tiles.
whyWeLikeIt: It's easy enough for family game night but satisfying enough that experienced gamers keep coming back to it.

name: FROGG TOGGS Chilly Pad Cooling Towel, 33 x 13
shortDescription: A reusable 33 x 13 inch cooling towel made of hyper-evaporative material that activates when wet and wrung out.
description: The FROGG TOGGS Chilly Pad is made of an exclusive hyper-evaporative PVA material that holds water while feeling dry to the touch, per the listing. Wet it, wring it out and snap it to activate; it's described as cooling up to 30 degrees and absorbing up to 8 times its weight in water. It measures 33 x 13 inches and comes with a storage tube. This is the Hivis Lime Green color.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a simple way to stay comfortable in the heat at games, theme parks, hikes or yard work.

name: W&P Peak Extra Large Cube Ice Tray with Lid, Charcoal
shortDescription: A silicone ice tray that makes four 2.25-inch cubes, with a steel-reinforced rim, a protective lid and individually molded compartments.
description: The W&P Peak tray makes four 2.25-inch cubes for cocktails and iced coffee, per the listing. A silicone-wrapped steel rim keeps it rigid when filling, each compartment is molded separately so single cubes pop out easily, and the lid keeps out freezer odors and lets trays stack. It's made of LFGB-grade, BPA-free silicone and is dishwasher safe. This is the charcoal version.
whyWeLikeIt: Big cubes melt slowly and look great in a glass, which makes home cocktails feel a little more special.

name: Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
shortDescription: Nintendo's official full-size wireless controller for Switch, with motion controls, rumble and a USB-C charging cable.
description: The Nintendo Switch Pro Controller is a full-size, ergonomic wireless gamepad for Nintendo Switch with motion sensing and rumble, per the listing. It charges via the included USB-C to USB-A cable. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: Its full-size grip is comfortable for long sessions on a Switch in TV mode.

name: The Woobles Beginner Crochet Kit, Fred the Dinosaur
shortDescription: An all-in-one beginner crochet kit to make Fred the Dinosaur, with pre-started yarn, hook, needle, safety eyes, stuffing and video tutorials.
description: The Woobles kit includes everything to crochet Fred the Dinosaur: Easy Peasy Yarn custom-made for beginners, a pre-started piece, a hook, a needle, safety eyes, stuffing and step-by-step video tutorials, per the listing. The yarn is designed to make stitches easy to see. It's recommended for ages 12+.
whyWeLikeIt: It takes a total beginner to a finished cute plushie, which is a very satisfying first craft project.

name: Hues and Cues Color Guessing Party Game
shortDescription: A party game for 3-10 players ages 8+ where one- and two-word clues guide everyone to a color among 480 hues.
description: In Hues and Cues, players use one- or two-word clues to guide others to a specific color on a board of 480 hues, per the listing. The rules are simple and quick to learn, rounds are fast-paced, and no two games play the same. It's for 3-10 players ages 8 and up.
whyWeLikeIt: It gets big groups laughing about how differently everyone sees color, making it an easy party pick.

name: Conair Fabric Shaver and Lint Remover, White
shortDescription: A battery-operated fabric shaver with a 2-inch shaving head and 3 depth settings for removing pills, fuzz and lint.
description: Conair's fabric shaver removes fuzz, lint and pills from sweaters, clothing and furniture, per the listing. It has 3 adjustable depth settings for different fabrics, a large 2-inch shaving head and an ergonomic grip. It's cordless and battery-operated, and compact enough to pack in a drawer or suitcase. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes pilled sweaters look new again in minutes, which is a small but very satisfying fix.

name: What Do You Meme? Family Edition
shortDescription: The family-friendly version of the caption party game: match the funniest caption card to each photo card.
description: In What Do You Meme? Family Edition, players compete to create the funniest meme by choosing a caption card to match each round's photo card, per the listing. A rotating judge picks the winner each round. It includes cards, instructions and an easel, and is designed for kids, teens and adults.
whyWeLikeIt: It gets plenty of laughs at family gatherings and a party game that parents and kids can actually enjoy together.

name: Garmin Forerunner 55 GPS Running Watch, White
shortDescription: An easy-to-use GPS running watch with daily suggested workouts, PacePro guidance and up to 2 weeks of battery in smartwatch mode.
description: The Garmin Forerunner 55 uses GPS to track how far, how fast and where you've run, and monitors heart rate at the wrist (not a medical device), per the listing. It offers daily suggested workouts, race time predictions and PacePro pace guidance, plus activity profiles for running, cycling, pool swimming, Pilates, HIIT and more. Battery life is up to 2 weeks in smartwatch mode and up to 20 hours in GPS mode. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a simple, reliable running watch that helps new runners train with a plan instead of guessing.

name: Scrabble Classic Board Game
shortDescription: The classic crossword game for 2-4 players ages 8+, with 100 wooden letter tiles, wooden racks and a textured board.
description: This Scrabble edition includes 100 wooden letter tiles and wooden racks, and a textured gameboard helps keep tiles in place, per the listing. Players build words for points, using premium squares to multiply scores, head-to-head or in teams. It's for 2-4 players ages 8+ and includes a guide with tips.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a timeless game that works for families, couples and competitive word lovers alike.

name: Lusso Gear Backseat Car Organizer, Black
shortDescription: A back-of-seat organizer and kick mat with 12 large pockets, a tablet holder and water bottle holders.
description: The Lusso Gear backseat organizer hangs on the back of a front seat and doubles as a kick mat against kids' feet, per the listing. It has 12 large storage pockets, including a clear tablet/iPad holder and bottle holders, with reinforced material to hold toys, books and road-trip essentials. It's made of waterproof, scratchproof Oxford fabric. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: It keeps road-trip clutter off the floor and saves the back of the seats from muddy shoes.

name: Hasbro Bop It! Electronic Game
shortDescription: The fast-paced electronic reaction game: follow the commands to Bop It, Twist It and Pull It as the speed increases.
description: Bop It! calls out commands to take 3 actions, bop, twist and pull, in random order, and players must react quickly, per the listing. It has solo and pass-it multiplayer modes and is portable for on-the-go fun. It's for ages 8+ and uses 2 AAA batteries.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a simple, addictive game that gets kids and adults competing for a high score.

name: Land Guard Galvanized Raised Garden Bed, 4 x 2 x 1 ft
shortDescription: An oval 4 x 2 x 1 ft galvanized metal raised garden bed with an open base that assembles in about 5 minutes.
description: The Land Guard raised bed measures 4 x 2 x 1 ft (about 7.14 cubic feet), per the listing. It's made of Q195 galvanized steel with double-layer anti-corrosion coating in an oval shape, with sheet thickness averaging 0.78 mm. The open base helps drainage, and it takes about 5 minutes to assemble. This is the silver version.
whyWeLikeIt: A raised bed makes growing vegetables or herbs easy on a patio or small yard, and it goes up in minutes.

name: Fancii Taylor Lighted Travel Makeup Mirror, 10x/1x
shortDescription: A slim 5-inch rechargeable compact mirror with 1x and 10x magnification and 3 dimmable LED light settings.
description: The Fancii Taylor has a double-sided 1x and 10x magnifying mirror with a 5-inch distortion-free view, per the listing. Its LED lighting offers 3 dimmable settings (warm, neutral and natural daylight), and the rechargeable battery lasts up to 30 days per charge. It's slim enough for a purse. This is the Marble Rose version.
whyWeLikeIt: Good, adjustable light makes makeup easy anywhere, from a hotel bathroom to a car.

name: Monopoly Deal Card Game
shortDescription: The fast card version of Monopoly for 2-5 players ages 8+: collect 3 complete property sets to win, in about 15 minutes.
description: Monopoly Deal packs the property-trading game into a 110-card deck, per the listing. Be the first to collect 3 complete property sets in different colors, using Action Cards to collect rent, steal and swap properties. A game takes as little as 15 minutes, and reference cards make it easy to learn. It's for 2-5 players ages 8+.
whyWeLikeIt: It's fast, tiny and competitive, which makes it one of the easiest games to bring on a trip.

name: Kasa Smart Plug Ultra Mini EP10, 4-Pack
shortDescription: Four compact 15A Wi-Fi smart plugs that work with Alexa and Google Home for voice control, schedules and remote on/off.
description: The Kasa EP10 4-pack includes four ultra-mini 15A smart plugs, per the listing. They connect to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi with no hub required and work with Alexa and Google Assistant for voice control. The Kasa app turns devices on and off from anywhere and sets timers and schedules for lamps, fans and holiday lights. They're UL certified and carry a 2-year warranty.
whyWeLikeIt: Smart plugs are the cheapest way to automate lamps and holiday lights, and a 4-pack covers the whole house.

name: Crayola Inspiration Art Case, 140 Pieces, Tie-Dye
shortDescription: A 140-piece portable kids' art set in a tie-dye case, with markers, colored pencils, crayons and paper.
description: Crayola's Inspiration Art Case includes 40 washable markers, 20 short colored pencils, 64 crayons and 15 sheets of 9 x 13 inch paper, per the listing. Everything stores in a sturdy tie-dye case with trays and compartments that keep supplies organized and portable. The supplies are nontoxic. It's recommended for ages 5+.
whyWeLikeIt: It's the classic kids' art gift: everything needed in one tidy case that's easy to take anywhere.

name: Topeak Mini 9 Bike Multi-Tool
shortDescription: A 3.2 oz folding bike multi-tool with 9 functions, including hex keys, a Torx T25 and a Phillips screwdriver, in a neoprene pouch.
description: The Topeak Mini 9 includes Allen wrenches from 2 to 8 mm, a Torx T25 wrench and a #2 Phillips screwdriver, per the listing. The tools are hardened chrome vanadium steel in an extruded aluminum body. It measures about 2.6 x 1.2 x 0.8 inches, weighs 3.2 oz and comes with a neoprene storage bag.
whyWeLikeIt: It fits in a saddle bag or pocket and handles almost every roadside adjustment.

name: Presto Pizzazz Plus Rotating Oven
shortDescription: A countertop rotating pizza oven with separately controlled top and bottom heating elements, a timer and a removable nonstick pan.
description: The Presto Pizzazz Plus has a rotating tray that turns continuously for even baking, per the listing. Top and bottom heating elements are controlled separately, so you can choose top, bottom or both. A timer signals the end of cooking and turns the elements off, and the removable nonstick pan is easy to clean. Presto says it uses up to 60% less energy than a conventional oven.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes crispy frozen pizzas, wings and snacks without heating up the whole kitchen, and kids love watching it spin.

name: Hamilton Beach Breakfast Sandwich Maker
shortDescription: A single breakfast sandwich maker with an egg cooker ring that assembles and cooks a sandwich in a few minutes.
description: The Hamilton Beach Breakfast Sandwich Maker cooks a complete sandwich with your own bread, eggs, cheese and precooked meat in just a few minutes, per the listing. You layer ingredients in 4 steps, cook, and slide out the finished sandwich. All removable parts are dishwasher safe, and the nonstick surfaces are PFAS-free. Hamilton Beach offers 25+ recipes online. This is the black single version.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns a hurried morning into a hot homemade breakfast sandwich with almost no effort.

name: WOD Nation Adjustable Speed Jump Rope, Blue
shortDescription: An adjustable-length steel-cable speed rope built for fast spins and double unders.
description: The WOD Nation speed rope uses a coated alloy steel cable with a stable, fast swing designed for workouts and double unders, per the listing. The length is adjustable with a wire cutter, and it's meant for smooth gym surfaces to protect the coating. This is the blue version.
whyWeLikeIt: A jump rope is the most portable piece of fitness gear there is, and a quality speed rope makes it fun to improve.

name: Alpha Grillers 4-Piece Stainless Steel Grill Tools Set
shortDescription: A heavy-duty 4-piece stainless steel BBQ set with a spatula with bottle opener, locking tongs, a fork and a silicone basting brush.
description: The Alpha Grillers set includes a serrated-edge spatula with a bottle opener, lockable tongs, a grill fork and a silicone basting brush, per the listing. The tools are extra-thick, rust-resistant stainless steel with scalloped grips and ergonomic handles, work with gas, charcoal, electric and smoker grills, and are dishwasher safe.
whyWeLikeIt: Sturdy tools make grilling easier and safer, and the set comes gift-ready for any backyard cook.

name: ApudArmis Six Player Croquet Set, 28-Inch Mallets
shortDescription: A complete 6-player backyard croquet set with 28-inch rubberwood mallets, colored balls, wickets, stakes and a zip-up carry bag.
description: The ApudArmis croquet set includes six 28-inch mallets, six colored balls, wickets and stakes, per the listing. The mallet heads are made of rubberwood, the set is quick to set up and learn, and everything packs into a nylon zip-up carry bag. It works on lawns, backyards and beaches.
whyWeLikeIt: Croquet is a relaxed, all-ages lawn game that makes any backyard gathering feel like an event.

name: EcoNour Foldable Windshield Sun Shade, Medium
shortDescription: A pop-open 240T polyester windshield sun shade with an expandable overlap design that folds into a storage pouch.
description: The EcoNour sun shade is made of 240T polyester and pops open to install in seconds, per the listing. An overlapping design expands up to 8 inches for a secure fit, and it folds compactly into the included storage bag. It comes in multiple sizes; this is the Medium (about 64 x 32 inches), and the listing includes a size chart to match your vehicle.
whyWeLikeIt: It keeps the car noticeably more comfortable on hot days and packs away in seconds.

name: Cuisinart Power Advantage 5-Speed Hand Mixer, White
shortDescription: A 220-watt 5-speed hand mixer with extra-long post-free beaters, a swivel cord, a recipe book and a 3-year warranty.
description: The Cuisinart Power Advantage hand mixer has a 220-watt motor with 5 speeds and a slow start, per the listing. Its extra-long, dishwasher-safe beaters have no center post, so batter doesn't clog them, and the 60-inch swivel cord works for right- or left-handed use. It includes a recipe book and carries a limited 3-year warranty. This is the white version.
whyWeLikeIt: A good hand mixer handles cookies, whipped cream and mashed potatoes without hauling out a stand mixer.

name: ENOVI EasyGo Portable Badminton Set with Net
shortDescription: A portable badminton set with a tool-free net, 4 steel rackets and 4 shuttlecocks that all pack into a box that doubles as the net base.
description: The ENOVI EasyGo set includes a storage box that doubles as the net base, two support poles, a net, four steel rackets and four shuttlecocks, per the listing. The net assembles without tools in 3 steps in about 30 seconds, and everything packs back into the box, which weighs under 5 pounds.
whyWeLikeIt: It sets up in seconds anywhere, from the backyard to the beach, which means badminton actually gets played.

name: Easthills Outdoors Instant Shader Deluxe XL Beach Tent, Pacific Blue
shortDescription: A pop-up beach tent for 4-6 people with UPF 50+ fabric, a 99-inch-wide interior, an extended floor porch and large mesh windows.
description: The Easthills Outdoors Instant Shader Deluxe XL has UPF 50+ fabric with a silver coating, per the listing. Its interior measures 99 x 53 x 57 inches with a 53-inch front porch, and a patent-pending opening mechanism makes setup and takedown easier. Large mesh windows and guy-out points help airflow. It weighs about 8 lbs. This is the Pacific Blue version.
whyWeLikeIt: A quick-up shade tent turns a long beach day with kids into a much more comfortable one.

name: Hot Wheels Track Creator Deluxe Pack with 2 Cars
shortDescription: A Hot Wheels track expansion with 25 feet of Speed Snap Track in 3 sizes, 2 die-cast 1:64 cars and adapters for older track.
description: The Hot Wheels Track Creator Deluxe Pack includes 25 feet of Speed Snap Track with 3 sizes of straight and flex track, plus 2 Hot Wheels cars so kids can start racing right away, per the listing. Kids can build an original layout or add to existing sets, and 2 adapters connect Speed Snap Track to older Hot Wheels track.
whyWeLikeIt: Loads of track means endless new layouts, and it works with the Hot Wheels sets many kids already own.

name: Globlazer F70 Pro 70-Inch Cat Tree, Light Grey
shortDescription: A 70-inch multi-level cat tower with a condo, a large hammock, a removable top perch, sisal scratching posts and two climbing paths.
description: The Globlazer F70 Pro stands about 70 inches tall, per the listing. It has a spacious condo, an enlarged square hammock, a removable top perch for cleaning, four sisal-wrapped scratching posts plus a scratching board, and two climbing routes. Parts are labeled and an assembly video is available. It measures about 21.7 x 17.7 inches at the base. This is the light grey version.
whyWeLikeIt: A tall, sturdy tree gives indoor cats a place to climb, scratch and lounge that isn't the furniture.

name: LickiMat Classic Buddy Lick Mat, Orange
shortDescription: A textured food-grade TPR lick mat for spreading yogurt, peanut butter or wet food as a slow, long-lasting treat.
description: The LickiMat Classic Buddy is a textured mat for serving spreadable treats like yogurt, peanut butter and purées, which settle into the mat's surface so pets take longer to finish, per the listing. It's made of non-toxic food-grade TPR (no silicone) and is dishwasher safe. LickiMat notes it isn't a chew toy and pets should be supervised. This is the orange version.
whyWeLikeIt: Freezing a spread-covered mat makes an easy boredom-buster for crate time, bath time or a busy afternoon.

name: OXO Good Grips 3-in-1 Avocado Slicer
shortDescription: An all-in-one avocado tool that splits, pits and slices, with a stainless steel pitter and a soft non-slip grip.
description: The OXO Good Grips 3-in-1 Avocado Slicer splits avocados, removes the pit with a twist of its stainless steel pitter and lifts the fruit from the skin in seven slices, per the listing. It has a soft, comfortable non-slip grip and is top-rack dishwasher safe.
whyWeLikeIt: It makes avocado toast and guacamole faster and safer than wrestling with a knife.

name: CHI Original 1" Ceramic Flat Iron
shortDescription: A 1-inch ceramic floating-plate flat iron that heats to 392°F, with an 11 ft swivel cord and dual voltage for travel.
description: The CHI Original flat iron has 1-inch ceramic floating plates for even heat, and it heats quickly to a set 392°F with a simple on/off switch (no adjustable heat), per the listing. It can straighten, curl and flip hair, has an ergonomic design with an 11 ft swivel cord, and is dual voltage for travel.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a simple, long-trusted flat iron that works the same at home or abroad.

name: Kurgo Rover Hammock Dog Seat Cover, 55" Wide, Black
shortDescription: A water- and stain-resistant, machine-washable back-seat hammock for dogs, 55 inches wide with 6 attachment points.
description: The Kurgo Rover hammock seat cover protects the back seat from mud and pet hair, and hangs between the front and back seats as a barrier to keep dogs from climbing forward, per the listing. It's water resistant, stain resistant and machine washable, measures 55 inches wide by 56 inches long, and uses 6 attachment points to stay in place. This is the black version.
whyWeLikeIt: It keeps the back seat clean after muddy walks and keeps the dog comfortably in the back.

name: Crock-Pot 7-Quart Manual Slow Cooker, Stainless Steel
shortDescription: A family-size 7-quart slow cooker with high, low and warm settings and dishwasher-safe removable stoneware.
description: The Crock-Pot 7-Quart Manual Slow Cooker has high and low cooking settings plus a warm function for serving, per the listing. The removable stoneware and lid are dishwasher safe, and the stoneware can also go in the microwave or an oven up to 400°F. It has a stainless steel exterior with black accents.
whyWeLikeIt: Set it in the morning and come home to dinner, which is exactly what busy families need.

name: HONBO Large Delta Kite with Rainbow Tails
shortDescription: A beginner-friendly 54 x 31 inch delta kite with twin 13 ft rainbow tails and a 300 ft line on a handle.
description: The HONBO delta kite measures 54 x 31 inches and is made of 210 ripstop polyester with a fiberglass frame, per the listing. It has two 13 ft rainbow tails, comes partially pre-assembled with instructions, and includes a 300 ft anti-tangle flying line on a handle.
whyWeLikeIt: It's an easy kite for kids to get in the air, which makes beach days and park trips more memorable.

name: Wilson NFL Super Grip Composite Football, Official Size
shortDescription: An official-size composite football with NFL lacing, a soft grippy cover and a Pressure Lock bladder that holds air longer.
description: The Wilson NFL Super Grip football uses a soft composite cover balanced for feel and toughness, with classic NFL-style laces, per the listing. A Pressure Lock bladder helps it stay inflated longer. This is the official size, intended for high school and college players ages 14+.
whyWeLikeIt: It's a durable backyard and park football with a grip that makes throwing and catching easier.

name: Cuisinart Portable 2-Burner Tabletop Gas Grill
shortDescription: A 22 lb tabletop propane grill with two 10,000 BTU stainless steel burners, electronic ignition, a thermometer and folding legs.
description: The Cuisinart Chef's Style portable grill has two stainless steel burners at 10,000 BTU each with electronic ignition, per the listing. Stainless steel grates deliver even heat, and an integrated thermometer and separate burner knobs give control. It weighs 22 lbs with a locking lid, folding legs and a carry handle, and sets up in under 10 minutes.
whyWeLikeIt: It brings full-size grilling to tailgates, campsites and small balconies, then packs up like a suitcase.

name: Sculpey III Oven-Bake Polymer Clay, 8 oz, White
shortDescription: An 8 oz bar of soft, beginner-friendly oven-bake polymer clay that stays soft until baked in a home oven.
description: Sculpey III is a soft, easy-to-use oven-bake polymer clay that doesn't air dry, so it stays workable until baked in a home oven, per the listing. Leftover clay can be stored and reused. It's non-toxic and suited to beginners and parent-child projects, and the white bar can be used alone or mixed with other colors. This is an 8 oz bar.
whyWeLikeIt: Polymer clay is a relaxing hobby for making charms, jewelry and little figurines, and white is the most versatile color to start with.

name: Buffalo Games Darrell Bush Canoe Lake 1000-Piece Puzzle
shortDescription: A 1000-piece jigsaw of Darrell Bush's lakeside sunset canoe scene, made in the USA with a full-size reference poster.
description: This Buffalo Games puzzle features Darrell Bush's Canoe Lake artwork, a sunset scene with a canoe at a lakeside cabin, per the listing. The 1000 pieces are precision cut from premium cardboard with a snug fit, a full-size reference poster is included, and it's made in the USA. It's frameable once finished.
whyWeLikeIt: A cozy scene and quality pieces make it a relaxing puzzle for a quiet weekend.

name: Franklin Sports Blackhawk Pop-Up Soccer Goal, 4' x 3'
shortDescription: A portable 4 x 3 ft pop-up soccer goal with a fiberglass frame and all-weather net that folds flat into a carry bag.
description: The Franklin Sports Blackhawk goal pops up for backyard or indoor soccer practice, per the listing. It has a fiberglass frame, all-weather netting and ground stakes, and folds flat into the included carry bag. This is the 4 x 3 ft Optic Yellow version.
whyWeLikeIt: It turns any yard into a pitch in seconds, and it's light enough to take to the park.

name: Prismacolor Premier Colored Pencils, 48 Count
shortDescription: A tin of 48 soft-core Prismacolor Premier colored pencils with richly saturated, lightfast pigments.
description: Prismacolor Premier pencils have thick, soft cores with lightfast, richly saturated pigments for smooth, even laydown and easy shading, per the listing. The leads are made to resist cracking and chipping, and the 48 assorted colors come in a tin case for storage and travel.
whyWeLikeIt: They're a long-time favorite of artists and adult colorists for how easily the colors blend.

name: Spalding Street Outdoor Basketball, Size 7
shortDescription: An official size 7 (29.5") rubber basketball designed for outdoor courts.
description: The Spalding Street basketball is an official size 7 (29.5-inch) ball with a performance rubber cover designed for outdoor play, per the listing. This is the orange Street version.
whyWeLikeIt: A durable outdoor ball is all you need for driveway and park pickup games.
